Our team brings over a decade of industry and research experience in plasma physics, nuclear engineering, and electrical engineering with backgrounds at SpaceX, Tesla, Columbia University, and University of Pennsylvania.

vora-ai.name: Vora AI
vora-ai.long_description: Vora gives every hiring manager an AI recruiter. Our AI agent, Rachel, automates talent sourcing by handling everything from identifying top talent, to writing personalized outreach to scheduling interviews directly on the hiring manager's calendar. This allows teams to focus on what matters most - talking to and closing the best candidates.

tejas-ai.name: Tejas AI
tejas-ai.long_description: Tejas AI eliminates uncertainty, allowing decision-makers to develop and evaluate credit rules more quickly and effectively.

caseflood-ai.name: Caseflood.ai
caseflood-ai.one_liner: How elite law firms do intake

weave-3.name: Weave
weave-3.long_description: Weave uses AI to understand engineering.

maive.name: Maive
maive.long_description: Maive is an AI automation platform for contractors providing home services

salespatriot.name: SalesPatriot
salespatriot.one_liner: We help defense firms win more contracts with the Pentagon
salespatriot.long_description:
SalesPatriot is a back-office operating system for defense firms. It helps you find, review, and bid on RFQ solicitations, both directly with the Pentagon and as a subcontractor.

US Government procures billions of dollars worth of parts and products every year, yet the procedure is riddled with red tape and repetitive, manual work.

Nelson worked at a manufacturing firm during his gap year prior to attending Berkeley. As the Chief of Staff, he witnessed first-hand the tedious process of finding great contract opportunities, the lengthy solicitation preparation process, and paper-based communication between departments.

He teamed up with Ben and Maciej, whom he met during Berkeley's M.E.T. admit day. Both of them had extensive experience in AI research and applications, which they applied to creating a powerful framework for humans and AI agents to collaborate during the lifecycle of a contract.

With SalesPatriot, your firm can run on autopilot - we find suitable contracts automatically, ingest RFQs from primes, streamline the communication between the departments, and provide analytics to improve your win rate.

Wether you are a manufacturer, reseller, or distributor, SalesPatriot can reduce your manual tasks, increase throughput, and boost your revenue.

sift-dev.name: Sift Dev
sift-dev.one_liner: Never Look at a Log Again
sift-dev.long_description:
Logging is broken. Engineers waste hours in endless data.
Sift Dev is building a future where you never read another log - starting with an AI pipeline to identify what matters and silence the noise.
sift-dev.tags: AIOps, Developer Tools, Generative AI, SaaS

carecycle.name: careCycle
carecycle.one_liner: Voice AI teams for medicare agencies.
carecycle.long_description:
careCycle is an AI workforce for medicare agencies and FMOs - helping leading agencies achieve 5x higher conversions, 37% better retention, and saving thousands of agent hours.

We're transforming how Medicare agencies handle member relationships with teams of voice AI agents. We're solving the industry's biggest challenge: 50% annual member churn caused by poor post-enrollment engagement.

Our multi-agent AI teams work together to handle the entire customer journey - from initial contact through enrollment and ongoing care. When a lead comes in after hours, one AI agent answers and schedules a callback, another calls at the perfect time, a third captures qualifying information, and a fourth handles the warm transfer to a licensed agent. This approach helped a leading FMO write over $2M in renewals during AEP 2024 while reducing agent talk time by 20% per sale.

We've pioneered a purpose-built solution for Medicare's unique compliance requirements. Unlike generic AI platforms, our system features built-in HIPAA/CMS compliance, real-time data structuring, and seamless CRM integration. This enables agencies of all sizes to deliver enterprise-grade member care without massive infrastructure investments.

Early metrics show the power of our approach:

- 5x increase in after-hours conversion rates
- 37% improvement in 90-day retention
- 3,000+ agent hours saved in a single AEP
- $2M+ in additional renewals during AEP 2024

The Medicare Advantage market represents a massive opportunity, with over $360B in annual premiums and growing 10% year over year. By solving the member retention challenge, we're positioning ourselves to capture significant value by transforming the member care experience for beneficiaries.

inversion-semiconductor.name: Inversion Semiconductor
inversion-semiconductor.one_liner: Manufacturing the most powerful chips, 15x faster
inversion-semiconductor.long_description:
Inversion Semiconductor is developing the next-generation chip fabrication machine, to create the most powerful chips 15x faster. Our vision is to reshore advanced chip fabrication capabilities in the West.

We're building a lithography machine. Lithography uses light to pattern circuit features on silicon. We're scaling transistors to their physical limits by shrinking particle accelerators 1000x, to create a high power light source. 

Using our light source we will double transistor density for a given numerical aperture and 3x throughput.

adam.name: Adam
adam.long_description: Adam is building AI CAD. It transforms text into parametric designs so engineering teams can ship 10x faster. Our mission is to eliminate the gap between engineering and reality so more great ideas come into existence.

rally-3.name: Rally
rally-3.long_description:
Rally is a financial platform for businesses that operate vehicle fleets. We're starting in Europe, where over €1 trillion is spent annually on fuel, charging, maintenance, and other fleet expenses - most of it still running on legacy networks built in the 1960s.

We set a new standard for fleet finance by streamlining payments and automating workflows across bookkeeping, credit, and driver payroll, helping real-world businesses like delivery services, construction crews, and service technicians stay in control and operate efficiently.

tergle.name: Tergle
tergle.long_description: Tergle builds AI to replace Auditors.

nuclear-software.name: Nuclear Software
nuclear-software.long_description:
Nuclear Software is the first continuous integration platform built for engineering simulations, designed for complex industries like nuclear, aerospace, automotive, and advanced manufacturing. It connects CAD models directly to simulation tools—neutronics, CFD, structural analysis, thermal simulations, and more—without manual data preparation. By automating geometry conversions and meshing, Nuclear Software eliminates bottlenecks and streamlines workflows, allowing engineers to focus on building better products.

Every design change automatically triggers simulations through a unified pipeline, ensuring real-time validation, version control, and traceability. Teams can customize workflows for individual components or run full system simulations, all within the same platform. Nuclear Software securely stores both designs and simulation results in a centralized repository, maintaining a complete version history linked to each design change. This single source of truth makes it easy to track progress, troubleshoot issues, and maintain accountability, reducing the risk of costly mistakes.

Nuclear Software’s robust access control system protects proprietary and regulated simulation codes, ensuring compliance and data security. By automating simulation workflows and connecting design iterations to real-time validation, Nuclear Software accelerates development cycles and empowers engineers to innovate faster and with greater precision.

amby-health.name: Amby Health
amby-health.long_description: Amby Health automates billing and quality reviews for ambulance agencies (EMS), replacing large back-office teams with AI. We analyze patient reports in seconds—not months—accurately coding claims and identifying liability and care risks while eliminating costly, error-prone manual processes.

cardamon.name: Cardamon
cardamon.one_liner: AI compliance co-pilot for regulated financial businesses
cardamon.long_description:
Cardamon is an AI powered platform that ingests relevant regulation, understands what applies to each regulated financial firm, and gets compliance officers from regulation, to obligations, to product requirements in minutes - not weeks.

Financial firms face a host of complex regulations that make it incredibly painful to launch and maintain products in a compliant way. As a Product team at Revolut, we felt this pain deeply ourselves - we had products ready to launch but stuck in compliance limbo, often for weeks. Turns out, getting compliant took as long as building the product itself. 

Frustrated, we dug in and were shocked by how manual and inefficient the processes were. That’s when it clicked: there’s a huge opportunity to automate the boring stuff (and solve our own problem!). Compliance teams win because they ditch the tedious tasks. Product teams win because they ship faster. Everyone’s happy.

zeroentropy.name: ZeroEntropy
zeroentropy.one_liner: High accuracy search API over unstructured data.
zeroentropy.long_description:
We are on a mission to build the world’s most accurate search engine over complex and unstructured documents.

Most AI products - whether Q&A bots or AI agents - depend on retrieval systems to provide relevant context from knowledge bases.

Yet, the vast majority of these systems rely on basic semantic or hybrid search methods, which still frequently fail. 

These mistakes lead to inaccurate responses and hallucinations by LLMs, frustrating developers and end users alike. 

That is why we’re building ZeroEntropy: to add intelligence to retrieval and empower developers to create AI products that are more reliable and accurate.

oki.name: Oki
oki.long_description:
Oki AI tells you everything you need to know to run your company.

By reading your team’s code, tickets, messages, and more, Oki delivers personalized - and interactive - updates daily to you and other leaders.

mosaic-2.name: Mosaic
mosaic-2.long_description: Mosaic's canvas enables anyone to create and run their own multimodal video editing agents. Our mission is to accelerate hours of video editing work to seconds.

gulp.name: Gulp
gulp.long_description: We're building Osmosis: an API that helps AI agents learn from experience, in real-time. | https://gulp.ai/responsive-software.html

operand.name: Operand
operand.long_description:
Operand works with leading private equity funds across the deal lifecycle, from commercial due diligence through post-close value creation. 

Operand uses proprietary data collection agents and machine learning systems to generate informational alpha for funds, including four of the ten largest private equity mega-funds in the US. 

In October 2025, the Operand 'Quant' topped OpenAI's MLE-Benchmark, achieving state-of-the-art performance and beating OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google. MLE-Benchmark measures the abilities of long-horizon, autonomous agents on competition-style machine learning and data science problems.

healthkey.name: HealthKey
healthkey.one_liner: AI-powered Patient Identification for Clinical Trials
healthkey.long_description:
HealthKey helps doctors offices generate more revenue by finding eligible patients for their clinical trials. We match at-risk patients with cutting-edge treatments, ultimately getting patients access to potentially life-changing treatments faster.

Big Pharma pays a lot of money to clinics for each patient they enroll, but finding patients who qualify is an entirely manual process today. We use AI to prescreen doctors’ existing patients against Clinical Trials’ eligibility criteria, making enrollment fast and easy.

gradewiz.name: GradeWiz
gradewiz.long_description: GradeWiz is an AI assistant that helps educators create rubrics, grade student work and give detailed feedback on handwritten worksheets and tests, saving 4+ hrs a week

mecha-health.name: Mecha Health
mecha-health.one_liner: Foundation models to automate x-ray analysis for radiologists
mecha-health.long_description:
Mecha Health builds foundation models to automate x-ray analysis for radiologists. We take medical images and process them using proprietary models to produce accurate draft medical reports. Our first model was built in less than two months, and beat Microsoft, Google, and OpenAI on clinical accuracy metrics. On top of that, it’s two orders of magnitude smaller and trained with a quarter of the data.

We are partnering with the largest privately owned radiology practice in the US and a multinational tele-radiology company to provide them with their own foundation model, enabling their radiologists to go from reading 1 scan per hour to 1 scan every 5 minutes. By charging on a per scan basis, x-ray report generation represents a 40B+ market opportunity.

cuckoo-labs.name: Cuckoo Labs
cuckoo-labs.one_liner: Real-time AI translator for global sales and marketing
cuckoo-labs.long_description:
Cuckoo is a real-time AI translator for global sales, marketing, and support. Companies like Snowflake and PagerDuty use Cuckoo in Zoom and in-person meetings for even the most technical discussions.

Cuckoo instantly learns the technical details of your conversation from your keywords and documents and interprets into over 20 languages—customized for your specific industry and organization.

finbar.name: finbar
finbar.long_description: finbar is the AI investment analyst used by several top-20 (AUM) hedge funds. It automates financial modelling, research, and data analysis so multi-million-dollar decisions can be made 100x faster.

hud.name: hud
hud.one_liner: Platform for building RL environments and evals
hud.long_description:
HUD (YC W25) is developing agentic evals and RL environments for Computer Use Agents (CUAs) that browse the web for frontier AI labs. Our CUA Evals framework is the first comprehensive evaluation tool for CUAs.

People don't actually know if AI agents are working reliably. To make AI agents work in the real world, we need detailed evals for a huge range of tasks.

We're backed by Y Combinator, and work closely with frontier AI labs to provide agent evaluation and training infrastructure at scale.

olive.name: Olive
olive.one_liner: The context layer for your team

pax-markets.name: PAX Markets
pax-markets.one_liner: More 𝛼, less latency: exchange and HFT on one chip.
pax-markets.long_description:
PAX is a new crypto CEX that delivers more 𝛼 with its in-silicon exchange and HFT technology. The PAX exchange integrated on-chip λ API provides deterministic nanosecond tick-to-trade latency. HFT λ traders experience non-adverse counterparty selection by pairing with free-tier traders who access PAX using our zero-cost & always rebated legacy API.

Using our patented technology, PAX is building a new generation of exchange co-lo facilities that unite HFT with exchange and monetizing by vertically integrating exchange and platform technology as one.

pave-robotics.name: Pave Robotics
pave-robotics.long_description: Pave Robotics builds robots that seal cracks in asphalt, helping paving companies save time and money. Our robots work 24/7 and deliver higher-quality results than humans.

gale.name: Gale
gale.long_description: Gale is an immigration tech platform that makes immigration simple for US companies. We've simplified the visa application process, streamlined compliance, and can integrate with HR systems - saving teams time, money and headaches. Through automation, we enable the independent attorneys we coordinate with to maintain quality whilst being more efficient.

asteroid.name: Asteroid
asteroid.one_liner: AI Browser Workforce for Operations Teams
asteroid.long_description: Asteroid builds and hosts AI browser agents for back-office tasks. With guardrails, evaluations, and human oversight, we deliver enterprise-grade reliability across millions of operations, even in regulated industries. Companies can build agents themselves or rely on us to deliver and maintain them.

macadamia.name: Macadamia
macadamia.one_liner: AI Agents for Complex Engineering Projects
macadamia.long_description:
Macadamia builds AI agents for complex engineering projects. 
They automate both engineering & business processes, to automate away all low-leverage work.
It integrates with all engineering data sources, technical documentation, and third-party software tools.
Macadamia serves customers in mechanical engineering, manufacturing, and construction.

lucid.name: Lucid
lucid.long_description:
We are building universe simulations powered by interactive video models.

We train video models that simulate hyper-realistic environments with immersive control, replacing hard-coded game or physics engines with dynamic neural networks.

We built the fastest action-conditioned diffusion video model (running at 20+fps on a 4090 gaming gpu) to simulate minecraft. It is 5x faster than other minecraft World Models and was trained with 100x less resources. Our unique insight was relying on aggressive compression in our tokenizer (128x versus the traditional 8x), and because attention scales quadratically with # of tokens our model can run blindingly faster.

Now we’re training a hyper realistic world model!

pickle-2.name: Pickle
pickle-2.one_liner: Where your life context becomes understanding.
pickle-2.long_description: Pickle is a personal, memory-based operating system, the missing layer of AI that continuously learns your real-world context, preferences, and intent, enabling AI to evolve with you and become truly proactive rather than reactive. Our system spans both software (Chat, our web-based creative intelligence app) and hardware (Pickle 1, our AI-powered AR glasses) to capture different layers of personal context. Together, they form the foundation of a real personal intelligence.

bindwell.name: Bindwell
bindwell.long_description: We're developing better, safer pesticides in-house using custom AI models.

augento.name: Augento
augento.long_description:
Augento is the platform for DeepSeek R1 (like) fine tuning as a service. A user gives us an Agent and where it went wrong and we'll improve it.
We provide a turn key solution to customers to act on poorly performing agents, by providing feedback in our UI to the agent and we'll take care of improving the model with reinforcement learning.
Imagine a startup developing a tool for law firms, enhanced with an AI to assist lawyers in selecting clients. Currently, this startup would face significant challenges in building such a tool, as it’s crucial to provide accurate and consistent responses every time. With our technology, the startup can enhance the initial model by incorporating its own experience and feedback from beta users, eventually surpassing the initial model and delivering reliable results on every query.

harbera.name: Harbera
harbera.long_description: Harbera helps clinic keep their doctors credentialed and compliant. Our AI software continuously monitors and proactively helps admin teams re-credential doctors, preventing denied claims, disruptions in patient care, and lost revenue caused by doctors falling out-of-network.

cenote.name: Cenote
cenote.one_liner: AI agents that convert and retain patients for digital clinics
cenote.long_description:
Cenote builds AI sales reps for online health clinics and deploys them for abandoned-cart and win-back campaigns.

Today, digital and telehealth clinics rely on generic text blasts or human follow-up for speed-to-lead and customer reactivation. Since the lead has often gone cold and the outreach isn’t personalized, conversion is frequently below 1%.

Cenote’s AI agents reach out immediately, communicate on the patient’s preferred schedule, and operate across channels—dramatically increasing conversion rates and unlocking revenue that otherwise goes unrealized.

lopus-ai.name: Lopus AI
lopus-ai.long_description:
Growth and product teams are drowning in disconnected data—HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, PostHog, QuickBooks. The result: leaders can’t trust dashboards, data teams get buried in ad-hoc requests, and deal teams burn days stitching context instead of driving revenue.

We have built Lopus, an AI-powered growth analytics platform, that unifies structured and unstructured data into one governed workspace. Powered by an agentic semantic layer, it understands your company definitions, joins marketing + CRM + billing + product, and delivers fast, explainable answers with lineage back to the source—turning every question into a lever for growth, so leaders know what is actually driving pipeline and converting to revenue.

Made for Founders, GTM, and Product leaders.

athenahq.name: AthenaHQ
athenahq.one_liner: Be the Answer in AI Search - AI SEO across SEO, GEO & AEO
athenahq.long_description:
Make sure your brand doesn’t get left behind as search shifts from traditional SEO to generative AI search.

AthenaHQ is an AI SEO platform for GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), helping brands show up in AI-generated answers across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and more.

AI search is expected to overtake traditional search within the next few years. AthenaHQ fills the gap with a system to measure visibility, identify what AI engines cite and recommend, and help your team improve content and brand presence for AI-first discovery.

Team of former product manager on Google Search's information acquisition team, Deepmind Generative Media team, and ChatGPT superusers.

strike.name: Strike
strike.one_liner: Transforming betting into a sophisticated asset class
strike.long_description: Strike is a daily fantasy sports platform that leverages options-style contracts to reward user conviction. By offering continuous payouts instead of binary outcomes, we aim to help transform daily fantasy sports and ultimately all event contracts from a casual pastime into a sophisticated asset class.

g-lnk.name: G LNK
g-lnk.one_liner: Simplifying Collaboration for Healthcare Organizations & Professionals
g-lnk.long_description: G LNK is an AI-powered platform simplifying how healthcare companies connect with the relevant medical professionals. Our proprietary matching and ranking models instantly identify the most qualified experts, accelerating drug development and commercialization. Designed with compliance at its core, G LNK ensures every connection meets strict regulatory and ethical standards—empowering companies to innovate faster with confidence.

mundo-ai.name: Mundo AI
mundo-ai.one_liner: High Quality Multilingual Training Data for AI Models
mundo-ai.long_description: AI models are terrible in non-English languages because it's nearly impossible to find training data in other languages. So, we're building the world's largest and highest-quality multilingual data library.

lucidic-ai.name: Lucidic AI
lucidic-ai.long_description:
As AI agents take on more consequential workflows, the hard part isn’t just whether they work—it’s whether they behave consistently with your company’s knowledge, policies, and expectations. Lucidic AI turns that institutional knowledge into consistent agent behavior by continuously testing, stress-simulating, and auto-optimizing agents against your real production scenarios.
Lucidic ingests your real logs, edge cases, and operational rules, then uses controlled simulations, reinforcement learning, and Bayesian optimization to automatically discover failure modes, propose targeted fixes, and verify improvements before anything reaches production. Instead of relying on manual prompt fiddling or guesswork, your agents get a continuous improvement loop: they’re tested, corrected, and optimized based on what your business actually requires—not what a generic model assumes.
The result is AI agents that reliably follow your domain logic, adapt to changes, and stay aligned across clients, configurations, and environments—without you needing to hand-engineer every prompt or behavior.

sophris.name: Sophris
sophris.one_liner: The AI Engineer for Electronic Design
sophris.long_description:
Sophris is your AI “engineer” for circuit board schematics, checking for errors—pin mismatches, connectivity gaps, or voltage conflicts—long before they derail your design. By flagging potential issues early, you can fix them ahead of production and avoid the frustrating re-spins that drive up costs and delay schedules.

While traditional EDA tools offer basic ERC and DRC checks—like net connectivity and spacing—they don't dig deeply into component datasheets. Sophris takes it further, analyzing specs and cross-referencing design requirements from multiple sources. As a result, subtle pin misconfigurations, voltage mismatches, and datasheet-specific quirks that typical rule checks might miss are brought to light.

By identifying design flaws during the schematic phase, Sophris helps you iterate confidently and deliver more reliable products. Faster turnarounds, fewer production surprises, and a smoother path from concept to manufacturing. With Sophris, design more confidently and ship more reliably.
sophris.tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Design Tools, Electronics

trata.name: Trata
trata.one_liner: AI-powered research desk for hedge funds
trata.long_description: Trata is an AI-powered research desk for hedge funds. We use agents to interview hedge fund analysts, write investment research, and distribute this through a subscription.

solidroad.name: Solidroad
solidroad.one_liner: AI agents for CX teams, starting with training and QA.
solidroad.long_description:
Solidroad builds AI agents for CX teams, starting with training and QA. Solidroad agents train human reps in a simulated environment, and evaluate their performance in live customer channels.

By starting with training and QA, our agents learn how humans learn, and their performance can be compared directly with human reps. This enables us to prove the value of the rest of the agents on our roadmap.

Since launching last summer, we’ve reduced onboarding times by 50% at several of the world’s largest outsourced contact centres/BPOs like PartnerHero and Tech Mahindra, and improved go-live CSAT at Crypto.com by 3% (now above 90% CSAT).

general-trajectory.name: General Trajectory
general-trajectory.long_description: General Trajectory is using AI to solve the world's most important problems, from autonomous defense to scientific R&D.

rejot.name: ReJot
rejot.one_liner: We turn complex API integrations into drop‑in full‑stack libraries
rejot.long_description:
ReJot is building Fragno to let API companies go from simply exposing an API to offering drop-in integrations that work out of the box.

Fragno is an open‑source framework for packaging backend endpoints, data storage patterns, and frontend utilities into reusable building blocks. API providers ship full integrations, not just low‑level SDKs and docs.

Customers configure rather than write code, so integrations are both much faster to launch and far more consistent across customers.

agentin-ai.name: Agentin AI
agentin-ai.one_liner: AI Agents that automate enterprise software processes
agentin-ai.long_description: At Agentin AI, we build Agents that move data and take actions across enterprise systems, like Salesforce, NetSuite and SAP. These agents are difficult to build because each enterprise heavily customizes their systems but we solved that by training our Agents to learn and adapt from failures, applying reinforcement learning techniques we developed.

vovana.name: Vovana
vovana.one_liner: AI recruiter built for frontline hiring
vovana.long_description: Vovana is an AI recruiter for filling high-volume, high-turnover roles in retail, logistics, restaurants, and hospitality. Our AI posts job ads, then gets on a phone call with candidates and interviews them just like a manager would.

waypoint-transit.name: Waypoint Transit
waypoint-transit.one_liner: We automate urban planning so cities can build cheaper and faster.
waypoint-transit.long_description:
Waypoint Transit is an AI city planner that generates civil infrastructure studies. Cities spend $50B/year on planning. With Waypoint, cities can generate reports in months rather than years, and at 30% of the cost.

Varun and Ryan met at Stanford, where they graduated with degrees in CS and EE respectively. Before founding Waypoint, Varun worked on AI at Microsoft and Ryan worked on chip design at Apple.

US cities are facing three major crises: congestion, budget deficits, and climate change. At the same time, city governments are understaffed and frequently need to contract work out to expensive consultants. Leveraging recent advancements in AI, we empower cities to reduce their costs, build infrastructure, and respond to problems quickly.

In the United States, state and local governments spend $50B/year on planning. Through automation, we can redefine the existing transportation and urban planning consulting markets.

For more information, visit waypointtransit.com or contact us at contact@waypointtransit.com.

riviera.name: Riviera
riviera.long_description:
Riviera builds AI Employees for Hotels. Our first agent is a hotel phone receptionist that lets hotels spend less time answering phone calls and more time helping customers. Our system handles front-desk inquiries, in-room dining orders, and reservations. It answers every question instantly and in any language, 24/7.

We are solving a problem that older phone systems and IVRs can't: customers hate not being able to talk to someone immediately, but most travel businesses can’t dedicate additional staff to manage phone lines. Voice AI has always seemed out of reach because the technology infrastructure in the travel industry is often fragmented, with reservation systems, loyalty programs, and in-house operations software that weren’t designed with voice AI in mind. Riviera addresses this by integrating seamlessly with existing software providers and using human-sounding voice models that are highly trained on data specific to each business type and department.

Hotels spend hundreds of billions annually on staffing and risk losing potential revenue when phone lines are overwhelmed or callers hang up. By enabling them to handle unlimited calls, day or night, Riviera unlocks additional revenue and eases labor challenges.

confident-ai.name: Confident AI
confident-ai.one_liner: The LLM Eval and Observability Platform for AI Quality
confident-ai.long_description: Confident AI allows companies of all sizes to benchmark, safeguard, and improve LLM applications, with best-in-class metrics and guardrails powered by DeepEval. Built by the creators of DeepEval (12.6k stars, >3m monthly downloads), Confident AI is able to offer battle-tested, open-source evaluation algorithms while providing the infrastructure needed for teams to stay confident their LLM systems.

exla.name: Exla
exla.one_liner: An SDK to run transformer models anywhere
exla.long_description:
Exla aggressively quantizes AI models to minimize memory usage and maximize inference speed. Whether you're deploying LLMs, VLMs, VLAs, or custom models, Exla reduces memory footprint by up to 80% and accelerates inference by 3–20x - all with just a few lines of code.

https://cal.com/exla-ai/schedule

karsa.name: Karsa
karsa.long_description: Karsa is a stablecoin neobank for over 100M people in emerging markets. We enable people to buy dollar-denominated stablecoins, save money in US bank accounts, and spend anywhere with a Visa card.

nitrode.name: Nitrode
nitrode.one_liner: Data for reasoning agents in dynamic environments
nitrode.long_description: Nitrode builds high-quality game data to train and evaluate LLMs and agents on spatial and temporal reasoning. Today’s models are trained on static text and images, but struggle to understand how the world evolves over time. We create small, fully specified game environments that generate ground-truth data on state, transitions, and hidden dynamics. This enables AI systems to move beyond simple pattern matching, incorporating memory, causality, and multi-step reasoning to create more reliable agents in dynamic environments.

calltree-ai.name: Calltree AI
calltree-ai.one_liner: Enterprise-grade AI support reps for call centers
calltree-ai.long_description: Calltree makes enterprise-grade AI support reps for call centers. Our AI reps take voice calls and chats like other AI support agents but can also use internal enterprise tools like a homegrown CRM or internal dashboards, like the highly trained humans working there today.
calltree-ai.tags: Generative AI, SaaS, B2B, Customer Service, AI

harper.name: Harper
harper.long_description:
At Harper, we are building a fully autonomous commercial insurance brokerage powered by AI. Our initial focus is on mid-sized businesses with complex insurance needs, but our vision is to eventually serve every business in the country.

By leveraging AI to automate key workflows in the insurance process, we efficiently secure optimal coverage for each client's unique requirements at competitive prices and with rapid turnaround. Our AI system learns from the expertise of our brokers, accumulating not just knowledge but also the specific workflows, data, and capabilities that pave the way to full autonomy.

tire-swing.name: Tire Swing
tire-swing.long_description:
Tire Swing uses AI to power resident and applicant eligibility evaluations for affordable housing.

Our software manages the resident certification and recertification process end-to-end for public and private properties supported by Project Based Rental Assistance, Low Income Housing Tax Credit, and Housing Vouchers. It serves as a drop-in replacement for third-party consultants and auditors, and helps compliance staff complete their work faster and more accurately.

outlit.name: Outlit
outlit.long_description: Outlit turns all your customer context across Stripe, PostHog, HubSpot, Slack, email, and more into one unified record so you can query across every tool and let agents monitor and act on signals across your stack.

mesh-2.name: Mesh
mesh-2.one_liner: Eliminating accrual spreadsheets for faster month-end
mesh-2.long_description:
Month-end shouldn’t be a race against the clock.

For most mid-to-enterprise finance teams, accruals are a manual bottleneck. Chasing missing invoices and manually updating spreadsheets can eat up 4+ days of every month-end close.

Mesh changes the timeline. We automate 90% of the accruals process by capturing real-time usage and service signals directly from your AP inbox, Slack, Teams, and historical journals. We turn fragmented data into audit-ready outputs, so you can stop guessing and start closing.

See how top teams are accelerating their close by 4+ days at www.usemesh.com

orbital-operations.name: Orbital Operations
orbital-operations.one_liner: High Thrust Space Vehicles for Satellite Defense
orbital-operations.long_description:
Orbital Operations is developing a high thrust, reusable space vehicle for satellite defense. We protect critical satellites, like GPS and Military communication satellites, from adversarial threats, like China and Russia.

Our vehicle will use the exact same propulsion systems that launch vehicles have used for decades by implementing a cryogenic management system. This will give us over 100x the thrust or current in-space propulsion.

Ross and I have over 15 years of combined aerospace experience across NASA, Aerojet Rocketdyne, SpaceX, Blue Origin, and Relativity Space. We’ve worked side by side for more than 3.5 years developing propulsion systems, turbomachinery, and building our own respective engineering teams.

We are currently working on the first demo of our unique cryo management system and intend to launch an operational vehicle by 2027.

sennu-ai.name: Sennu AI
sennu-ai.one_liner: AI Code Review for Salesforce Development
sennu-ai.long_description: Sennu AI reviews every pull request with full context of your Salesforce codebase like a senior Salesforce architect would

infinite.name: Infinite
infinite.long_description: Infinite is a stablecoin payment processor. We offer businesses turnkey APIs and SDKs to instantly move money anywhere in the world at a fraction of the cost of traditional solutions.

peppr-ai.name: Peppr AI
peppr-ai.one_liner: Self-improving knowledge base synthesizing scattered company data
peppr-ai.long_description: We turn scattered company data into a dynamic, self-improving knowledge hub to fuel faster decisions across your organization

triplezip.name: TripleZip
triplezip.long_description: TripleZip is a platform that automates accounting for commercial real estate using AI. CRE firms use TripleZip to save up to 95% on accounting compared to hiring an outside firm for complex tasks like CAM reconciliation and budgeting.

artificial-societies.name: Artificial Societies
artificial-societies.one_liner: We build networks of AI personas that simulate stakeholder opinions
artificial-societies.long_description:
Artificial Societies simulates how large groups of people respond to opinion surveys and react to information. We help global F100 enterprises anticipate how their most important stakeholders react to their most important decisions: from how investors and opinion-leaders react to comms messaging, to how high-value customers react to marketing strategies.

We are experts in human behaviour. James, our Founder and CEO, is a Cambridge psychologist and data scientist who led the seminal paper that studied how 33,000 AI chatbots interact. Patrick, our Founder and Chief Product Officer, is an Applied Behavioural Scientist with years of experience helping F500 enterprises conduct market research. They are joined by a team of behavioural scientists, social scientists, and political scientists, all with a passion for uniting technology and an understanding of humanity.

We know that every public-facing enterprise decision has million-dollar consequences. From how to position towards opinion-leaders, industry peers, and policymakers, to which marketing content to invest in, knowing how stakeholders would react matters. But traditional market research methods are too slow, too expensive, and often just fail to
reach the stakeholders that truly matter.

We spend our lives solving this problem. Our offering is that we build bespoke AI
simulations of high-value audiences, for insights on questions no one else can answer. We’ve built up over 2.5 million AI personas that are all grounded in real human behaviour – not just what people say, but also what they do. 

But our enterprise partners choose us not just because we have achieved 95% accuracy in simulating human opinions compared to human self-replication - more importantly, they choose us because of our ability to deliver impossible research projects. Such as having insights in under 24 hours, such as being able to test sensitive strategies on high-value audiences with 100% security, without human risk.

As a result, we’ve delivered over 18 million responses to global Fortune 100 enterprises, that helped shape over 100 million dollars’ worth of decisions ranging from global expansion strategies, product positioning, advertising, and strategic communications.

Our vision of Artificial Societies is a Societal World Model that enables infinite experimentation, so that every organisation can have awareness of outcomes, before making a decision. No planes fly without a wind-tunnel; no medicines are approved without clinical trials; and yet, the biggest decision societies face today are taken as bets. We see Artificial Societies as a historically inevitable technology, and see it as our lives' mission to bring it to life.

miyagi-labs.name: Miyagi Labs
miyagi-labs.long_description:
Miyagi Labs is an AI-powered exam prep platform that helps students ace tests like the SAT and ACT through our AI tutor, personalized study plans, thousands of practice questions, and realistic practice exams.

We’re building the platform we wish we had when studying for exams. No more running out of practice questions. Track your progress as your rating in different exam categories increases, and know exactly what you need to practice most.

We envision a world where students anywhere can come to Miyagi to ace their exams and receive personalized, world-class AI tutoring designed to unlock their full potential.

fuseai.name: FuseAI
fuseai.one_liner: The #1 AI Platform for Outbound Sales.
fuseai.long_description:
FuseAI is the AI-native sales platform for modern revenue teams.

Built for high-performance outbound, FuseAI consolidates your entire GTM stack - data, enrichment, multi-channel automation, real-time buying signals, and AI-driven execution  into one seamless system.

With powerful integrations and intelligent workflows, FuseAI doesn’t just help you run campaigns. It turns every signal into pipeline, and every rep into a top performer.

misprint.name: Misprint
misprint.one_liner: Misprint is building Robinhood for Pokemon cards
misprint.long_description:
Misprint is an all-in-one marketplace that solves the biggest pain point in the collectibles world: opaque pricing. Collectors, investors, and hobbyists currently rely on scattered data from auction houses, online forums, and reseller platforms, making it difficult to know the true value of their items. Misprint streamlines the process by combining accurate pricing analytics with a seamless buy/sell marketplace, making it easier than ever to understand and monetize collectible assets.

Existing marketplaces lack robust, real-time analytics because accurate valuations require deep expertise in both the collectibles domain and advanced pricing algorithms. Misprint’s unique blend of insider trading card knowledge and machine learning allows us to fill this gap.

Building these pricing models requires extensive data infrastructure, deep domain expertise, and cutting-edge ML. Recent surges in the trading card market show that collectors crave transparent valuations.

The global collectibles market is worth tens of billions of dollars. Eva has experienced the scale of this industry firsthand, generating $500k ARR within three months of taking her Pokemon card-selling side hustle full-time. With additional segments like sports cards, comics, and emerging collectible categories, the growth runway is immense.

Co-founders Eva and Jon have been best friends since Exeter, combining finance expertise, a passion for collectibles, and mathematical rigor. By merging Goldman Sachs-level financial analytics with top-tier mathematical talent, Misprint is uniquely positioned to become the go-to platform for fair, transparent pricing in the collectibles space.

afterquery.name: AfterQuery
afterquery.one_liner: Research lab investigating the boundaries of AI capabilities.
afterquery.long_description: AfterQuery is a research lab (backed by Y Combinator) investigating the boundaries and capabilities of artificial intelligence through novel datasets and experimentation. We believe that pushing the frontiers of AI requires both rigorous scientific inquiry and exceptional human data.

mastra.name: Mastra
mastra.one_liner: The Javascript framework for building AI agents, from the Gatsby devs
mastra.long_description: Mastra is the easiest way to build a production AI application, built by the team that brought you Gatsby. We provide a complete set of AI primitives: workflows for complex operations, agents for autonomous decisions, RAG for knowledge integration, and evals for quality & accuracy. Mastra is open-source, modular, and built in Typescript for product developers. You can deploy Mastra on any cloud, and it gives you a straightforward syntax to solve the hardest problems building with AI: human-in-the-loop workflows, agent memory and tool selection, and output quality.

forge-automation.name: Forge Automation
forge-automation.long_description: Forge Automation runs software enabled factories that deliver custom metal parts in four days or less. Instead of mechanical engineers having to wait two to three weeks for their low volume CNC parts, they can simply upload a CAD model on our platform and we will ship it out in four days or less. We aim to give mechanical engineers the "Amazon experience" for custom metal parts.

archon.name: Archon
archon.one_liner: We help software companies sell to government.
archon.long_description:
Archon helps software companies sell to the government by cutting the required federal compliance timeline (called FedRAMP) down from 16 to 6 months and cuts costs by $1M per company. 

Email us at inquiries@archon.inc

retrofit.name: Retrofit
retrofit.one_liner: A vintage marketplace curated by AI
retrofit.long_description: Retrofit is reimagining the future of secondhand shopping. We are a new vintage marketplace that uses AI agents to curate and personalize in-demand, trending inventory. We analyze social media trends, sales data, and personal style to find the best vintage pieces that fit an individual’s unique taste, size, and budget.

pinch.name: Pinch
pinch.one_liner: Real-time AI Voice Translation for Developers
pinch.long_description: Robust live speech translation models with 50+ languages and simple integration

optifye-ai.name: Optifye.ai
optifye-ai.one_liner: AI performance monitoring for factory workers
optifye-ai.long_description:
Optifye.ai does AI performance monitoring for factory workers

We place cameras in factories and use vision AI to tell supervisors who's working and who's not in real time. 

The shop floor has historically been a black box. With Optifye, manufacturing companies can now accurately measure worker output and boost efficiency!

reditus-space.name: Reditus Space
reditus-space.long_description:
We are making reusable satellites for zero-g manufacturing. 
Our first full orbital recovery mission is set to launch in April 2026.

permitify.name: Permitify
permitify.one_liner: AI co-pilot for building plan review and building code compliance
permitify.long_description: City building departments are understaffed and overworked. Meanwhile, builders lobby to remove power from building departments. Because building departments are usually the only profitable/self-sustaining branch of a local government, this is problematic. Permitify allows city build-plan reviewers to 10x their productivity covering the labor shortage, reducing the time required to issue a building permit, and allowing the city government's only profitable branch to stay intact.

wildcard.name: Wildcard
wildcard.long_description:
Wildcard is the infrastructure platform for e-commerce brands to succeed in ChatGPT and AI shopping. We give brands SKU-level visibility into how their products appear and perform inside AI assistants—showing when they surface, why they don’t, and how to fix product attributes to improve discovery and conversion.

As AI shopping standardizes, Wildcard will help merchants activate next-generation experiences through the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP).

demeter.name: Demeter
demeter.one_liner: AI Value Creation Team for Private Equity
demeter.long_description: Demeter is the AI platform to maximize private investment returns. It enriches portfolio data with deep research to automate performance tracking and benchmarking for value creation.
demeter.tags: Finance, B2B, Workflow Automation, Investments, AI

proception-inc.name: Proception Inc
proception-inc.one_liner: Making humanoids dexterous enough to thread a needle

woz.name: Woz
woz.one_liner: Claude Code plugin that reduces token consumption and cost by 50%
woz.long_description:
WOZCODE is the highest performing, lowest cost AI coding agent. Available via Claude Code Plugin. 

The WOZCODE plugin outperforms Claude Code alone on all key metrics:

Cost: 25-55% cheaper
Speed: 5-10x faster on database tasks, 30-40% faster on most others
Performance: beats Claude code on Terminal Bench 2.0 (68% vs 58%)

Install with one command. Access directly via Claude Code

Your tools, your workflows, but Better, Faster, Cheaper.

spott.name: Spott
spott.long_description:
Spott is the first AI-native ATS/CRM for recruiting & staffing firms. We built Spott because existing recruitment platforms require extensive manual work, are clunky to use, rely on fragmented add-ons, and are not designed for AI adoption.

Spott combines everything recruiting firms need, from a full ATS & CRM to AI agents across the entire workflow, into one AI-native solution. It enables recruiters to focus on what matters most and close more placements.

rebolt.name: Rebolt
rebolt.long_description: Rebolt sits on top of your systems and builds tailor-made AI software - to drive outcomes

roark.name: Roark
roark.one_liner: Test, monitor, and improve your voice agents
roark.long_description:
Roark helps teams test, monitor, and improve their voice agents.

Voice AI is exploding, but reliability is still the #1 challenge. Teams spend hours manually testing agents and still miss failures. In the last 6 months, Roark has processed over 10M minutes of calls, powering monitoring and simulation for teams across the Voice AI ecosystem (including YC companies).

We close that gap by combining:

 📊 Monitoring & Evaluation - 40+ built-in metrics (latency, instruction-follow, sentiment, etc.), custom dashboards, alerts, and the ability to define your own. Up to 15 speakers with automatic speaker identification.
 🎭 Simulations & Personas - end-to-end phone/WebSocket simulations for inbound and outbound agents, with configurable personas (accents, languages, speech & behavior profiles). Define tests as conversations with a graph-based approach, so you can easily branch into edge cases and variants.
 🔁 Full lifecycle loop - failed calls automatically become repeatable tests, so every failure makes your agent stronger.

Roark is the missing QA layer for Voice AI - helping teams ship agents they can trust.

dalus.name: Dalus
dalus.long_description:
Dalus is an AI-powered systems engineering software to model/validate complex systems for aerospace/defense/robotics and other mission-critical industries. 

With Dalus, engineers can seamlessly trace requirements, perform analyses, and update information in real-time. This ensures that every team member stays aligned and informed, reducing inefficiencies and enabling faster iterations. 

With AI at our core, users can analyze hundreds of pages of existing engineering documentation and requirements to generate or retrieve information about the system model they are building in Dalus.

We started working together on Dalus in spring 2024 after Eliot quit his job at Aerojet Rocketdyne (L3Harris) where he worked as a test/systems engineer. He experienced first-hand how silos and poor communication reduced the productivity and efficiencies in the teams he worked at.

We love working with companies tackling complex engineering systems, whether they be startups just getting their feet wet or large organizations like Israel Aerospace Industries (Our design partner and biggest aerospace/defense company from Israel)

Read why we started Dalus: https://dalus.io/articles/why-dalus

opine.name: Opine
opine.long_description: Opine is social media for AI influencers. Instead of watching content on a feed, users chat with an AI influencer, who recommends content to them. The content is created by a human creator, but the chatting is done by an LLM. Together these create a new kind of influencer.

tensorpool.name: TensorPool
tensorpool.long_description: Our CLI makes ML model training effortless - just describe your job, and we handle GPU orchestration and execution at half the cost of major cloud providers.

bluebook.name: Bluebook
bluebook.long_description:
Bluebook is building AI agents for accounting firms to accelerate research, reconciliations and monthly closings. We allow professionals to serve 200 clients instead of just 20. With research time cut by 30% accountants can provide more strategic advice to help their clients thrive. The 30 leading firms in the Nordics already use Bluebook.

The accounting industry faces a perfect storm: a massive CPA retirement wave (75% in the coming 15 years), increasing complexity from globalization and new regulations, and private equity consolidation driving productivity demands. LLMs enables software that can understand context, adapt to new scenarios, and handle complex accounting tasks with human-like reasoning - capabilities that traditional rule-based software lacks.

pig.name: Pig
pig.one_liner: An API for automating Windows apps with AI
pig.long_description: Pig is an API to launch and automate Windows desktops. Pig's SDK tools plug into your agent loops to allow them to navigate UIs and integrate with software that doesn't have an API.
pig.tags: Developer Tools, Generative AI, Cloud Computing

paratus-health.name: Paratus Health
paratus-health.one_liner: Medical Voice Agents for Patient Management
paratus-health.long_description:
Paratus Health is the AI operations layer for outpatient clinics. We build autonomous agents that don’t just assist staff - they replace them, fully handling front desk calls, patient intake, insurance verification, documentation, and billing prep. Everything is deeply integrated into EHRs like Epic and Athena, eliminating the need for fragmented tools and manual work.
No toggling between systems. No busywork. Just one intelligent system running your clinical operations - faster, smarter, and more profitably than ever before.

copycat.name: CopyCat
copycat.long_description: CopyCat builds AI specifically for the insurance industry. We help brokers, carriers, and MGA's move faster and more efficiently for what will soon be the next generation of insurance operations.

ergo.name: Ergo
ergo.one_liner: AI agents and unified data layer for revenue teams
ergo.long_description: Ergo is the revenue infrastructure for teams growing faster than their systems can keep up. We connect the conversations your team is already having, across calls, email, Slack, and more, and build a unified data layer that moves deals forward.

tamlabs.name: TamLabs
tamlabs.long_description: TamLabs is an applied research lab redesigning how knowledge work gets done.

browser-use.name: Browser Use
browser-use.one_liner: Leading open-source web agent project with 50k stars in 3 months
browser-use.long_description:
We enable AI to control the browser. 
Browser-use is the biggest open-source web agent project. 
We got 40k stars in the last 3 months.

cedar.name: Cedar
cedar.one_liner: Execute the best sales playbook in industry
cedar.long_description:
Cedar helps the fastest growing GTM teams ramp up new reps faster & spread top rep playbook throughout the team. AE's at Cursor, Corgi, Pylon, and Warp use Cedar to save 75% of admin time on CRM updates, follow-ups, and deal strategy. 

Backed by YC with an ex-Figma, Notion, and Intuit team, Cedar was built by spending hundreds of hours with the best AE's in industry – we've built a playbook for the fastest growing teams and founders ramping up sales, and we'll use it to automate the busy work so you can sell more, better.

emojis-com.name: emojis.com
emojis-com.long_description: Our mission is to give small businesses an AI Graphic Designer to help them create a brand and identity without having to pay 💰💰💰 of dollars hire someone.

mercura.name: Mercura
mercura.one_liner: AI Quote and Order Automation for Distributors & Manufacturers
mercura.long_description: Mercura automates quotes and orders for distributors & manufacturers in the construction supply chain. Our software lets sales teams process requests in minutes instead of days. By eliminating repetitive back-office tasks, we help sales reps focus on winning more deals and driving revenue.

instinct.name: Instinct
instinct.long_description: Instinct is making the Moon the new LEO. Our small lunar lander is designed to be launched as a regular LEO rideshare, enabling higher mission cadence at a lower cost.

sammy-labs.name: SAMMY Labs
sammy-labs.one_liner: SAMMY Labs, the knowledge layer for your people and AI
sammy-labs.long_description:
At SAMMY, we do knowledge. Not “find me every time [thing] was mentioned,” but real knowledge. A compliance or legal update comes in — where does it apply, how does it affect our processes, and what should we do next?A process changes — which related processes need updating? Update them for me.

We’re trusted by some of the largest companies in the world to power their knowledge, because without knowledge, AI is just a bull**** exacerbator.

trainloop.name: TrainLoop
trainloop.long_description: TrainLoop makes it effortless for developers to supercharge LLM performance through reinforcement learning.

dexterity.name: Dexterity
dexterity.long_description:
Dex is the AI copilot built for the browser.

Most web agents are optimized for "set-and-forget" tasks—you hand them off and check back later. But what about the workflows you'd want to drive? Jumping between tabs, browsing sites, filling forms, and searching across apps—these experiences demand instant, context-aware models that work with you, not just for you.

Dex turns your browser into an intelligent workspace that understands your intent. With simple voice and text, it enhances familiar interfaces, automates mundane actions, and helps 10x your productivity on the browser.

No more slow handoffs. No more context-switching. Just AI that moves at your speed.
dexterity.tags: Generative AI, Productivity, Consumer Products, Automation, AI Assistant

axal.name: Axal
axal.one_liner: AI Workers for Manufacturing and Distribution
axal.long_description: Helping manufacturers and distributors eliminate manual work by automating operational processes with AI.

artifact-2.name: Artifact
artifact-2.one_liner: An Collaborative, AI-native IDE for Hardware Engineers
artifact-2.long_description:
Artifact is a collaborative IDE for hardware engineers - accelerating every step in the engineering lifecycle:

Design → Procurement → Manufacturing → Integration → Test → Sustainment

We've raised $3.5M to build an integrated, verifiable AI copilot with an intuitive UI that reflects how hardware actually gets built. Every artifact is auto-generated and traceable to a single-source of truth.

We believe hardware engineering should be rigorous, deliberate, and system-aware. We work directly with customers solving the world's hardest technical problems to modernize how complex hardware is engineered.

If you're interested, send your resume & contact info to: careers@artifact.engineer

assistant-ui.name: assistant-ui
assistant-ui.one_liner: Open Source React.js Library for AI Chat
assistant-ui.long_description: assistant-ui helps frontend developers add AI chat to their apps. Our product is used by several dozen companies, like LangChain, Stack AI, Browser Use, and Athena Intelligence. We're building an open source Typescript/React library and a backend as a service, with first class integrations into popular agent frameworks like LangGraph and Vercel AI SDK.

fira.name: Fira
fira.one_liner: Financial research platform for investment firms
fira.long_description:
Fira accelerates financial research for investment analysts by instantly searching and analyzing thousands of pages of company filings and earnings reports, delivering source-cited answers and verifiable calculations.

Our mission is to build a comprehensive research platform that integrates seamlessly with internal and external data sources, handles research and analysis, generates investment documents, and automates repetitive workflows. This frees investment professionals to focus on what matters most: building relationships and making strategic decisions.

vantel.name: Vantel
vantel.one_liner: AI Platform for Commercial Insurance Brokerages
vantel.long_description: AI-native OS for the commercial insurance brokerages.

blindpay.name: BlindPay
blindpay.long_description: BlindPay is a stablecoin API that enables companies to send and receive money worldwide using fiat money, stablecoins and multiple blockchains. We handle all the complex compliance and regulatory requirements, so companies can focus on their core business.

mentra.name: Mentra
mentra.one_liner: Building the open source smart glasses operating system.
mentra.long_description: Mentra is building the open source operating system for smart glasses. The smart glasses hardware is finally ready, so we're building the OS and app store to power the next computing platform.

red-barn-robotics.name: Red Barn Robotics
red-barn-robotics.one_liner: A Roomba for weeds on a farm.
red-barn-robotics.long_description: We are building an autonomous robot to precisely eliminate weeds and leave crops untouched. Despite $100 billion being spent annually on weed control, weeds still cost the US economy $46B/year. Weeds steal sunlight and nutrients from crops, forcing farmers to choose between higher costs and lower yields. Moreover, many farms still rely on hand labor to control weed growth. The process is slow, expensive, and increasingly difficult due to constant labor shortages (1 out of every 5 US farm positions go unfilled each year). Our robot nicknamed the Field Hand is able to automate one of the worst jobs on a farm and will help healthily feed the world.

playablai.name: Playabl.ai
playablai.one_liner: Prompt-to-play AI game builder for everyone
playablai.long_description: Playabl.ai is an AI game builder that lets anyone create games and interactive experiences by chatting with AI.

klaimee.name: Klaimee
klaimee.one_liner: Insurance for the agentic world. Starting with AI agent risk.
klaimee.long_description:
Klaimee certifies and insures autonomous AI agents.
We audit your agents and back them with AI-native liability coverage.
Built for startups bringing AI to enterprise clients, self-serve from day one.

gigacatalyst.name: Gigacatalyst
gigacatalyst.one_liner: Turn every customer workflow into a native part of your SaaS with AI
gigacatalyst.long_description:
We provide a white-label AI builder that learns your APIs and embeds in your product, so your customers can build their own apps on your SaaS. Each customer can now adapt your product to match their workflows perfectly and share it across their team with our in-built app store.

The result is that customers use your SaaS more, retain for longer, and expand quicker, because they get bespoke implementation for their exact usecase, without waiting.

We're live with the top Series B companies with 90% repeat usage rate. Our customers tell us that Gigacatalyst is the best way to increase usage, retention, and expansion for B2B vertical SaaS.

manicule.name: Manicule
manicule.long_description:
Manicule is an AI-native technical documentation agency. We own technical documentation end-to-end for developer tool companies, including information architecture, messaging, writing, design, and QA. Agents handle the mechanical parts like code verification and auditing at a scale and speed no human team can match, while humans refine the thinking and make the docs actually good. We're at $15K MRR and profitable, with clients like Supermemory, Greptile, Reducto, and Rootly. Supermemory's docs drove a 30% improvement in answer success rate and went viral on Twitter, all shipped in 23 days.

Every dev tool founder knows their docs are broken but simply don't have the time to fix them. The old solution was hiring a full-time technical writer who understands engineering, marketing, and devrel. That role is really hard and expensive to hire for, so docs stay broken. Naman started freelance writing for developer tools 3 years ago and realized that you can't one-shot docs. They require tight feedback loops with the engineering team, multiple review cycles, and real product understanding. When he worked with Supermemory, they had two products that sounded identical to customers. He got on calls with the CEO, figured out the right positioning for each product, and restructured the entire docs around it. That kind of work requires judgment and context that agents simply don’t have.

On the other hand, testing every code snippet against a live API, auditing hundreds of pages for broken links, and drafting from OpenAPI specs is grunt work that agents do in minutes. The insight behind Manicule is that good documentation requires both, and nobody has packaged them together. Shreyans was a founding engineer at Supermemory, saw the impact of good docs firsthand, and joined Naman to productize Manicule. We're now a team of 5, building toward that vision. Thousands of AI startups are launching dev tools every month, and docs are the single biggest asset they're all neglecting.

mochatrade.name: Mochatrade
mochatrade.one_liner: US stock perps for global traders
mochatrade.long_description: Mochatrade lets global traders trade perpetual futures on US stocks with up to 20x leverage. Access 50+ US stocks including TSLA, NVDA, AAPL. Mocha is fully self-custodial and no US brokerage account is needed. Traders on-ramp in local currencies and get professional-grade execution on the world's most liquid equities. Starting with India (140M+ demat account holders), and expanding across other markets.

indexable.name: Indexable
indexable.long_description: Sandbox infrastructure for AI agents, with full-environment forks and snapshots across files, processes, memory, and databases.

runtime.name: Runtime
runtime.one_liner: Let all your team ship safely with coding agents
runtime.long_description:
Runtime (runtm.com) gives engineering teams control and visibility to enable anyone in their org to use coding agents securely.

Eng leaders rolling out coding agents have no way to see what's happening, set boundaries, or safely let non-engineers use them. We provide sandboxed environments, session-level observability, and configurable guardrails so anyone on your team can ship with coding agents without breaking prod.

We're live with fast-growing YC scaleups empowering their PMs, designers, marketers, and ops to contribute to their codebase or build prod-grade zero-to-one apps.

pentagon.name: Pentagon
pentagon.one_liner: Your AI agents, working as a team.
pentagon.long_description: Pentagon is a workspace for your AI employees to communicate, coordinate, and get work done as a team.

arzana.name: Arzana
arzana.one_liner: AI automation for the manufacturing office
arzana.long_description: Fortune 500 companies and the fastest-growing manufacturing firms use Arzana’s AI platform to automate order entry, quoting, and customer updates. So teams can scale faster, respond sooner, and grow without adding overhead.

projectx.name: ProjectX
projectx.one_liner: Building Infinity: the cloud OS where humans and agents work together
projectx.long_description:
Infinity is one OS for every device. Any workflow, from anywhere.

Traditional operating systems are hardware-locked, driver-dependent, and were never built for agents. Spinning up AI agents today means wrestling with VMs, DevOps pipelines, and hard resource caps before a single workflow even runs. Every device has its own OS, its own limits, its own ceiling. The heaviest applications -- robotics simulators, CAD tools, AI workloads -- stay locked to the machines powerful enough to run them.

Infinity abstracts all of it away. Windows apps, Linux apps, and AI agents run in a single cloud-native environment -- streamed with dedicated GPU compute to any browser on any hardware, from a laptop to an Apple Watch. 

Run the heaviest apps from the lightest devices. Humans and agents share the same workspace with infinite compute and unlimited parallel workflows. One URL

openwork.name: OpenWork
openwork.one_liner: The open source alternative to Claude Cowork
openwork.long_description: OpenWork is a desktop app that lets people connect to their existing skills, MCPs, and agents. Users can download the app for free, try it with over 50+ model providers, and easily share their setup with their team.

amboras.name: Amboras
amboras.one_liner: Let AI sell your stuff on autopilot
amboras.long_description: Amboras puts your entire e-commerce on autopilot. It builds your store, continuously optimizes it, reads your analytics, and learns what converts - all autonomously. No developers. No agencies. No guessing. Today it sells to humans. Tomorrow it sells to AI agents.

testerarmy.name: TesterArmy
testerarmy.one_liner: AI QA agent that tests code before it ships
testerarmy.long_description: TesterArmy is an AI agent that tests your web app in a real browser before code ships. It runs automatically on every GitHub Pull Request, then posts recording, pass/fail results, and failure context as a PR comment. Teams also get a CLI for local/CI runs and an API for custom pipelines. We catch the regressions that code review misses.

edenrobotics.name: Eden
edenrobotics.long_description: We're building robots that just work and use them to deliver autonomous services at scale.

foaster.name: Foaster
foaster.one_liner: Map your company's operations, identify where and how to integrate AI
foaster.long_description:
Our agents map your company’s operations to identify where and how AI should be integrated.

Companies do not have a clear view of how work actually gets done. Their operations are spread across workflows, tools, teams, processes, and sometimes countries, with critical bottlenecks and inefficiencies hidden in the gaps. 

Before AI can truly transform a company, you first need a granular view of the tasks, handoffs, and dependencies that make up the business.

Foaster uses AI-led interviews to rebuild that map at scale through 45 minutes chats with employees. Our agents surface how work really happens across the organization, detect bottlenecks and inefficiencies, and then identify where AI can create the most leverage. 

Right now, AI can automate tasks but not entire job. The real challenge is understanding thousands of processes well enough to redesign them coherently. 

No human team can do that with enough speed or depth. AI can. In days.

saudara-ai.name: Saudara AI
saudara-ai.long_description:
Indonesian exports to the US grew 23% in 2025 up to over $30B. The shift is happening. Most brands just don't have the on-ramp yet.

Saudara AI is an AI-native sourcing agency connecting American brands with Indonesian suppliers across apparel, textiles, home goods, supplements, and raw materials. Our AI agent finds your factory, handles vetting, sampling, and delivery. A human is in the loop at every stage.

No more ghosting. No more waiting months for supplier updates. You always know where your order stands.

We are the on-ramp.

biostack-platforms.name: BioStack Platforms
biostack-platforms.one_liner: Real world training envs for healthcare AI models
biostack-platforms.long_description:
BioStack is building the data engine for healthcare and drug discovery AI. The bottleneck is not models. It is access to high-quality biological data. Clinical and experimental data is fragmented, unstructured, and locked inside hospitals, labs, and CROs, while generating new data is slow and expensive. BioStack fixes this with proprietary clinical and preclinical data pipelines that turn real biomedical workflows into ML-ready training environments.

We structure longitudinal multimodal data across imaging, EHR, and experimental assays, then package it for post-training and reinforcement learning so models can learn how research and care actually happen. Instead of static datasets, BioStack gives AI labs workflow-aligned data and environments that improve reasoning, decision-making, and real-world performance in biology and medicine.

kuli.name: Kuli
kuli.one_liner: Claude Cowork for social media and creator marketers
kuli.long_description:
Kuli is an AI agent for social media and influencer marketing teams at the world's largest consumer brands. Our agent watches every video on socials in the brand's context and helps marketers get work done to launch their campaigns 4x faster.

Previous platforms gave marketers databases to search through and a CRM. Kuli actually watches the content. Marketers at team like Supercell, Disney and Havas use it to scout creators, run analysis on trends and competitor strategies, and analyse what makes their campaign perform better.

For 10 years, influencer marketing meant more tools, more tabs, more spreadsheets. Kuli replaces all of that with one single agent you orchestrate. One marketer with Kuli does what a $50K/month agency bills for manual tasks.

tasklet-2.name: Tasklet
tasklet-2.one_liner: The cloud agent operating system for knowledge work
tasklet-2.long_description:
AI chatbots can answer questions, but they can't do your work — they aren't connected to your tools, can't take actions, and stop running when you close the tab. Meanwhile, knowledge workers are still spending most of their day switching between dozens of SaaS apps, manually stitching together workflows that should be automated.

Tasklet is the AI agent that actually does the work. It connects to every tool you use — via thousands of built-in integrations, any HTTP API, or MCP servers — and takes real actions on your behalf: pulling reports, updating CRMs, triaging emails, processing data, and more. When it needs a UI, it generates one on the fly. When it needs to crunch numbers or do bulk operations, it writes and runs code in a cloud sandbox. When it needs to interact with a website that doesn't have an API, it uses a real browser. And because it runs in the cloud 24/7, you can set up triggers to have it take ongoing responsibility for workflows — not just do something once, but handle it going forward.

The product is deliberately simple: a chat interface where you talk to an extremely capable agent. But underneath that simplicity is a cloud-native agent runtime, best-in-class context engineering, a universal connections layer, and multi-model support that keeps us on the frontier as AI improves. 

We think legacy SaaS is being unbundled by agents, and Tasklet is the operating system that ties it all together.

ara.name: Ara
ara.one_liner: personal ai cloud computing for everyone
ara.long_description:
Ara is building the fastest personal AI agent computing environment that works for you 24/7.
Users get instant cloud runtimes to run agents like OpenClaw in isolated environments, letting them organize files, send emails, and handle day-to-day tasks automatically.

datost.name: Datost
datost.one_liner: AI data analyst in Slack. Democratize data.
datost.long_description: The first AI data analyst that has its own computer. It sees and understands your docs, Slack, databases, data lakes, and codebase. Query, debug, and analyze right where your team works.

minicor.name: Minicor
minicor.one_liner: Managed, self healing desktop automation at scale
minicor.long_description:
AI companies selling into legacy industries can't go live because their customers' systems of record are Windows desktop apps with no APIs. The only way in is clicking through the UI, and it breaks constantly.

Minicor is a platform for building self-healing desktop automations at scale. Speak the automation into existence through your favourite coding agent via our MCP, or to us directly, and get an API endpoint to trigger it. One API call triggers a full desktop workflow on a Windows VM. On-premise, cloud, or Citrix.

Video replay, error logging, and scaling built in.

smol-machines.name: smol machines
smol-machines.one_liner: Ship software faster with portable, self contained virtual machines.
smol-machines.long_description:
Smol machines solve the problem of "but app works on my machine" by shipping the machine.

Smol machine enables devs to ship a lightweight virtual machine with any software, similar to how Electron ships an entire browser with the web app.

runharbor.name: Harbor
runharbor.one_liner: AI system-of-record for clinical trial data
runharbor.long_description:
Harbor is a new, AI-enabled system of record for clinical trial data that replaces legacy electronic data capture (EDC) systems. Today, medical device and pharma companies spend months setting up custom EDCs that research sites then spend hours per subject per day entering data into. With Harbor, the EDC is spun up simply by reading your clinical trial protocol and research sites upload raw source documents into the platform, skipping the tedious and error-prone data entry process altogether.

EDCs haven’t fundamentally changed since the 1990s. They are passive, regulatory compliant data bins that cause massive trial delays, coordinator burnout, and weeks of back-and-forth to resolve data errors. Because of this, data management currently consumes ~30% of total clinical trial budgets.

With LLM and document extraction capabilities finally reaching the accuracy, reliability, and traceability required in high-risk domains, Harbor is redefining the way data is collected and monitored in clinical trials, all while remaining fully GCP- and 21 CFR Part 11 compliant.

After months of building our initial product, our platform is now live with its first few clinical studies. For our largest customer and their 1600 subject randomized trial, we were able to use our internal tools to get their study database configured in just one week, which was ten times faster than legacy EDC vendors quoted.

We built Harbor because we lived through this problem. Albert spent four years in clinical trials and regulatory strategy for a medical device startup, spending weeks at clinical sites watching coordinators battle legacy software firsthand. Nate brings the technical firepower, having built scalable software at Google and Ramp and as employee #1 at a previous YC startup.

complir.name: Complir
complir.long_description: AI-powered product compliance platform that makes it easy for retailers to launch and scale products across borders without drowning in regulatory work. Complir's AI agents handle the regulations and documentation across every market you sell in - and keep your entire catalogue audit-ready.

aice-power.name: AICE Power
aice-power.long_description:
AICE Power makes a new generation of sensors that give commercial buildings full visibility into their energy consumption. 
We deploy on any site in one day with no disruption, at 5% the cost of traditional Building Management Systems. 
The platform automatically detects anomalies and alerts teams in real time, before inefficiencies show up on the bill.

alchemyai.name: Alchemy
alchemyai.one_liner: AI-powered image analysis for life sciences
alchemyai.long_description: Alchemy automates image analysis for life science researchers who spend hours every day turning images into useful numerical data, often manually. Through a combination of our customized pipeline tailored to the researcher's needs and our suite of ML models, we've helped labs reduce analysis time by over 90%, while enabling analyses that were previously impossible.
