lunabill.name: LunaBill
lunabill.one_liner: AI Voice callers for healthcare billing teams
lunabill.long_description:
LunaBill is building AI Voice callers for healthcare billing teams. Insurance claim follow-up calls account for the 80% of the daily workload of a healthcare billing team, with each call averaging 30 minutes.

Since our launch in July we are now at $764K in contracted ARR, of which $428K is live revenue and the rest will go live by January 2026. Our customers see a 10x increase in claims followed up per biller in the first week and we have converted 100% of pilots to paying customers. We have automated 50,000+ calls and signed partnerships with top healthcare leaders like UC health systems, Mayo, Experian Health and more.

The founders have known each other for over a year. Suhail is a 2x founder, with 3+ years of experience building in healthcare including operating a medical billing company with 200+ healthcare clients. David founded Skiesoft, Taiwan’s biggest healthcare AI scribe company, used by 120k+ healthcare professionals. He also worked as a data scientist at UCSF, building models to audit medical-coding accuracy. Yash was a researcher at various hospital systems including Mayo Clinic.

nerviom.name: Nerviom
nerviom.long_description:
Infrastructure projects like data centers, factories, and energy facilities require navigating hundreds of permits and regulatory approvals before construction can begin. 

Today this process is handled through consultants, spreadsheets, and thousands of pages of documentation, adding years to project timelines and millions in consulting costs.

We are building an AI autopilot to automate infrastructure permitting and regulatory compliance. 

Our goal is to significantly reduce the time and cost required to get infrastructure projects approved and built.

velvet.name: Velvet
velvet.one_liner: Helping AI pass the audiovisual Turing test
velvet.long_description: The platform where frontier research labs buy data to pass the audiovisual Turing test.

diligencesquared-inc.name: DiligenceSquared
diligencesquared-inc.one_liner: AI-powered market due diligence for investment decisions
diligencesquared-inc.long_description:
DiligenceSquared delivers AI-powered market due diligence for investment decisions - like the $500k McKinsey reports, but automated, auditable, and at a fraction of the cost.

When Private Equity funds evaluate deals, they pay firms like McKinsey, BCG, and Bain $500K-$1M for market due diligence. The process takes weeks, and the output is a static PowerPoint that's impossible to audit. A single large-cap PE fund can spend >$30M annually on this and the total market is $10B per year.

Our AI agents conduct expert interviews and synthesize insights with every claim linked to source transcripts. No black box, no "trust me" slides, and no 10x mark-up for human labor.

Frederik bought these reports as a Principal at Blackstone. Soren sold them as a Principal at BCG. Harshil is a repeat founder and former Software Engineer at Google. We've seen both sides and know what matters in due diligence - and now we automate it.

Our clients already include 8 leading private equity funds with over $2.4 trillion in combined AUM.

amera.name: Amera
amera.one_liner: Automating claims processing workflows for health insurance payers.
amera.long_description:
Amera automates claims processing for health insurance payers. We turn messy claim inputs (PDFs, bills, receipts, EDI and non-standard submissions) into structured data that plugs into existing systems. This cuts manual entry and exception handling, speeding up operations and reducing cost.

We are already working with payers / plan administrators representing ~100k members, giving them access to more affordable care options.

forge-robotics.name: Forge Robotics
forge-robotics.one_liner: A robotics intelligence system for metal fabrication
forge-robotics.long_description:
Forge Robotics is changing the way that metal parts are fabricated. We are enabling a future where our intelligent robotic system completes all steps needed to take raw metal stock and transform it into fully welded parts. 

Beginning with welding, we are building a robot-mounted vision system and AI feature detection that creates a real-time 3D map and tells the arm exactly where to go at every instant.

bluma.name: Bluma
bluma.long_description:
Bluma is the first AI short form content engine.

In a post-AI world, attention is the most valuable commodity. Social media is only growing faster and faster, and we're still early.

We automate your entire consumer marketing strategy by cloning your competitor's viral videos.

Everything that a growth team would plan, script, produce, and edit, Bluma can clone end-to-end and at scale.

lightberry.name: Lightberry
lightberry.long_description:
We build brains for robots.

We work with manufacturers like Unitree to make robots listen, speak, and act. You can program your robot out of the box by literally talking to it, no coding involved.

Robots running Lightberry are emotionally intelligent, always on, and fully autonomous. Just like in Star Wars!

the-hog.name: The Hog
the-hog.long_description:
TheHog.ai is the first predictive intelligence engine for growth. We don't just find leads; we predict your next customer before they enter the market.

TheHog.ai maps your ICP, channels, and opportunities across the internet, monitors competitors, communities, keywords, and turns signals into ranked actionable game plans.

The future of sales isn't a static dashboard; it is a living, autonomous command center. TheHog.ai gives a single operator the power of an entire sales and marketing teams by compressing weeks of research into minutes of execution.

The Hog Mind & Global Graph At our core is "The Hog Mind": a proprietary Contributory Global Graph that fuses real-time social listening with advanced identity resolution. Unlike traditional enrichment tools that rely on stale databases, The Hog monitors millions of live conversations across the internet to identify high-frequency intent signals. This creates a self-reinforcing data flywheel that ranks opportunities and triggers autonomous engagement workflows instantly.

What We Do:

Predictive Buying Intelligence: We map the "Global Graph" of customer nodes to surface opportunities before competitors know they exist.

Autonomous Engagement: An army of AI agents that don't just draft, but identify, verify, and engage with customers across LinkedIn, Reddit, and X.

Deep Data Enrichment: We bridge the gap between anonymous social signals and verified contact data, creating a holistic view of your market.

The Data Flywheel: A bottom-up network where every user interaction cleans and verifies our dataset, creating a defensive moat that gets smarter with every query.

The Result: Win your customers before it’s even a competition

telemetron-ai.name: Telemetron
telemetron-ai.one_liner: Support and Operations Platform for Hardware Companies
telemetron-ai.long_description:
Telemetron is an AI-powered support platform tailored for hardware products (medical devices, consumer electronics, industrial hardware, robotics, and more). 

Our platform unifies ticketing, device diagnostics, order tracking, and product documentation into one intelligent system. Our AI agents connect directly to devices, APIs, and backend systems to deliver faster resolutions, smarter routing, and better support experiences.

boom-ai.name: Boom AI
boom-ai.one_liner: AI growth team for e-commerce brands
boom-ai.long_description:
Boom builds the AI employee for e-commerce — an agent that manages every customer interaction across WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and web chat. It answers product questions, supports customers with orders, follows up on abandoned checkouts, restocks, and repeat purchases, and even runs marketing campaigns. Brands simply connect Boom to their store, and their AI agent instantly starts selling, supporting, and following up like a real team member — no setup or flow-building required.

E-commerce is a $6T market where brands spend heavily to bring customers in, only to lose over 99% of them before checkout. Boom fixes that by turning every missed conversation into a sales opportunity. Our clients increase conversion rates and deliver a concierge-like buying experience at scale. We believe that in the near future, every online store will have AI employees managing sales and customer relationships — and Boom is building the platform that makes that possible.

freeport-markets.name: Freeport Markets
freeport-markets.long_description: Freeport turns the sources you already trust (starting with Twitter) into a tradable feed. Our AI analysts track breaking news across social and financial media, distill what matters, and translate it into actionable trade ideas so you’re never late when markets move.

miniswap.name: Miniswap
miniswap.long_description:
Miniswap a marketplace for complex hobbies, starting with Warhammer.

In hobbies as complex as Warhammer, finding what you want on general marketplaces is a huge pain. Filters don't work, free-form listings mean that products are regularly misidentified, and piles of counterfeit junk crowd search results. 

Miniswap saves hobbyists from this chaos with its catalogue of more than 20,000 unique miniatures. Sellers match their listings against Miniswap's catalogue giving buyers more information and structure as they shop.

The global market for tabletop games is estimated to be worth $20B in 2025 and Warhammer alone is projected to grow to $3B by 2030. By capturing the market in this untapped niche, Miniswap is strongly positioned to bringing greater transparency, simplicity, and connectivity into adjacent verticals.

Miniswap's founding team merges deep domain knowledge with elite programming expertise and years of experience in business consulting and startups. Co-founders Zak and Will met while studying together at Cambridge, bonded over their love of Warhammer and early modern history. They have been best friends ever since.

rovi-health.name: Rovi Health
rovi-health.long_description:
We deliver high-quality, cost-effective healthcare to employees through text. Employers cut 10–20% of healthcare spend. Employees get concierge care that improves outcomes.

Our AI agents analyze clinical data to identify care needs. We treat common conditions through our integrated virtual clinic. For more complex care, our agents find the best in-network providers using millions of price and quality data points, and handle end-to-end appointment booking.

castari.name: Castari
castari.one_liner: Vercel for AI Agents – One click deploy for the Claude Agent SDK
castari.long_description:
Castari lets developers deploy AI agents in secure, autoscaling sandboxes with one command. We handle tool/MCP connectors, snapshots, and observability so teams go from prototype to production in hours instead of weeks.

Developers focus on building agents, Castari provides the autoscaling sandbox infrastructure to ensure your agents and its tools are secure.

generalastro.name: General Astronautics
generalastro.long_description: Robots for microgravity research and manufacturing.

jarmin.name: Jarmin
jarmin.long_description:
Jarmin.ai is your 24/7 ML eng employee that you hire. Just talk to Jarmin like any other employee and Jarmin handles your AI/ML work from there. Completely hand over full initiatives or individual tasks.

Jarmin’s founding team is from Meta SuperIntelligence Labs (Staff Engineers), Apple (Machine Learning Engineer), AWS (scaling infra), Lockheed-Martin (Research), and JPMorganChase (SWE) with experience building AI/ML and automating complex work of Researchers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers with AI.

exonic.name: Exonic
exonic.long_description:
What if you could train a biological foundation model on... the entire internet?

Exonic is pioneering a new generation of biological foundation models, focused on heterogeneous, unstructured, and noisy datasets.

Our first application is the design of safer gene therapies.

In 2025, we used AI to set a new state of the art in liver cancer targeted gene therapy, validated in vitro in our lab in San Francisco.

So far in 2026, we have trained a new model with unprecedented zero-shot generalization on genomic regulatory expression in hold-out biosample datasets. More to be shared soon.

uselemma.name: Lemma
uselemma.long_description:
Lemma enables AI agents to continuously improve from user feedback and production outcomes. Instead of relying on manual prompt tuning and reactive debugging, Lemma detects when an agent’s performance drifts, pinpoints the exact step causing failures, generates optimized prompt candidates, and automatically delivers improvements through our API or by opening a pull request in your codebase. 

Built by ex-AI engineers who felt this pain firsthand, Lemma turns static agents into self-improving systems, helping teams ship reliable AI products faster with compounding performance gains over time. 

Deploy 1x. Learn forever.

mantle.name: Mantle
mantle.one_liner: Build internal agents to automate back office work with one prompt
mantle.long_description:
Mantle connects to all your tools: your CRM, Mail, Calendar, Payments, Product Analytics, and more. With just one prompt, you can create agents that handle back office work for you.

These agents can automate reports  and email them to you, drafts emails right in your email client, generates pre-meeting research directly in your calendar event, and much more. They run quietly in the background, react to changes in real time, follow a schedule or work when you chat with them. 

You didn’t start up to stay stuck in admin. Turn your company AI-native with Mantle.

karumi.name: Karumi
karumi.long_description:
Karumi is an AI agent that joins a live video call with your prospects to deliver personalized product demos, 24/7, in any language.

It bridges the gap between your landing page and your sales team by engaging visitors at the peak of their interest, turning curiosity into conversion. For those not ready to talk to sales but eager to explore, Karumi offers the next generation of interactive, self-guided demos.

icarus.name: Icarus
icarus.long_description: Always-on intelligence and connectivity for Defense. Icarus builds autonomous, solar-powered aircraft that fly at 60,000 feet for weeks at a time, above the clouds harnessing the power of the Sun, but never too close. It’s the modern-day U-2 spy plane, except each costs $100K and is built by the thousands. The future of warfare is in the Stratosphere.

savahq.long_description: If you are a trusts & estates attorney, RIA, fintech, or family office interested in Sava, reach us at founders@savahq.com

Focused on SOX programs and financial regulations (SEC Rules etc.)

metorial.name: Metorial
metorial.one_liner: The infra layer for AI integrations.
metorial.long_description: Metorial is the infra layer for AI integrations. We built the only serverless MCP runtime that can maintain state with sub-second cold starts, built-in security, and monitoring. We make it easy for developers to connect AI agents to apps and data sources at scale.

Companies like Hims, Kalshi, Replit, and Brex use Absurd to create production-quality videos in 72 hours. We do it with a multi-agent orchestration layer, working closely with your team from concept to final cut.

Try it at absurd.com

We're hiring: absurd.com/careers

clad-labs.long_description: free codegen from brainrot workflows in your IDE.

Our mobile app uses LiDAR and computer vision to capture property details automatically, and our custom-trained AI agents combine that data with all the analysis and aggregation required to to generate a complete appraisal report in minutes. usenarrative.long_description: Narrative automates the creation and distribution of high-quality sports highlight videos for broadcasters, teams, and leagues.

crunched.name: Crunched
crunched.one_liner: Excel AI analyst for Power Users
crunched.long_description:
Crunched is the Excel AI analyst for power users - in consulting, investment banking, and private equity. It error-checks workbooks end-to-end, builds models from scratch, and handles grunt work like extracting and linking data from IMs to template models - all within Excel so teams can review and iterate as usual.

Agents struggle with tabular data - getting reliable, multi-step execution over thousands of interlinked formulas, sheets, and ranges is hard. Making Crunched good enough for people who live in Excel means knowing the pain points deeply.

Michael and Philip has 10,000+ hours in Excel across consulting and finance. Markus and Lars bring deep expertise in scaling AI and enterprise solutions.

We've had easy access to first customers and are already live with firms across six European countries - we now plan to expand into the US. With >1bn total Excel users, we focus on the top 2%, highest-value Excel users globally. 

We're solving one pain point at a time to create a product that doesn't just look good in a demo but actually works in production.

Excel is here to stay, but the way experts model is fundamentally changing - with Crunched.

lua-global-inc.name: Lua Global Inc
lua-global-inc.long_description:
Lua is the mid-market agent platform.

We deliver enterprise reliability with the speed, flexibility, and economics that mid-market companies demand - helping them deploy AI agents that drive sales, support, and operations across everyday channels and tools.

We scale through developer agencies and channel partners, enabling rapid distribution without a large enterprise sales motion or scaled forward deployed teams. We think of Lua as an agentOS that abstracts all of the complexity required to launch enterprise grade agents and combine it with the tools needed for these agents to succeed in the real world.

Lua was founded by Lorcan O Cathain (CEO) and Stefan Kruger (CTO)- experienced founders who have spent 15 - 20 years each scaling technology companies across emerging markets.

We sell to mid-market enterprises and developer agencies in the US and internationally. Developers are increasingly our primary ICP but we run SMB & enterprise sales motions to accelerate our learnings and further develop our product:
- SMB ($25- 1k per month): fully automated self-serve agents that handle sales and support for eCommerce companies, hotels, restaurants and general service businesses. If you’ve been on our website you’ve likely seen this.
- Enterprise: We directly sell to mid-market (~ $50M- $1BN) businesses across the US and internationally to eat our own dog food and strengthen our platform.

philon.long_description: Building open-source general-purpose robots capable of performing unsafe, repetitive or boring tasks.

sourcebot.name: Sourcebot
sourcebot.one_liner: Helping humans and AI agents understand massive codebases
sourcebot.long_description:
Sourcebot is an open source code understanding platform for massive codebases. We’re used by thousands of engineers in some of the largest companies in the world, including NVIDIA, Red Hat, Wikimedia, and Arista Networks.

Understanding code, not writing it, is the primary bottleneck for large engineering teams. For developers, this means onboarding onto complex codebases faster. For AI agents, it means getting the necessary code context to minimize hallucinations and maximize cohesion within the wider codebase.

Sourcebot solves this by giving developers and AI agents the ability to regex search across millions of lines of code instantly, as well as ask questions across thousands of repos using any flagship reasoning model. Being open source and on-prem, we can get deployed in enterprises within minutes before other tools even get approval.

We met a decade ago at McGill University and have been building together full time for over 2 years. We’ve personally felt the pain of understanding large codebases while working at Microsoft, EA, Ubisoft, Google, and Meta.

hireglide.name: HireGlide
hireglide.long_description: HireGlide is an AI-native recruiting agency. We use software and agents to find companies better people faster.

aside.name: Aside

aside.long_description:
Aside is an AI browser that acts on your behalf. Give it your passwords, browsing history, and browser context. It gets real work done end to end in the apps you already use, with no integrations required.

scott-ai.name: Scott AI
scott-ai.one_liner: Agentic Workspace for Engineering Team Alignment
scott-ai.long_description:
Scott AI is the agentic workspace where teams align on spec before any codegen runs.

An engineer will entrust a long-running agent to add dark-mode end-to-end while they pair carefully with an IDE-based agent to land a critical DB migration. These execution agents cannot be the decision layer because they are biased to their own tool, they are not neutral. Scott AI is the neutral, agent agnostic decision layer for the age of multi agent building. Teams will use Scott as their decision workspace to finally ditch google docs and notion as their primary spec alignment layer.

everest.name: Everest
everest.one_liner: Netflix for AI films and series
everest.long_description: We're an ex-Netflix team building the AI-native Netflix.

expected-parrot.name: Expected Parrot
expected-parrot.one_liner: Simulate your customers with AI agents
expected-parrot.long_description: Expected Parrot helps companies simulate their customers with AI agents to explore pricing, product, marketing, communications and other scenarios at scale. Our open-source library and no-code web app let you design custom agent personas and conduct interviews and surveys with them using LLMs of your choice to generate results and reports. imagine-ai.name: Imagine AI
imagine-ai.one_liner: We build B2B content for your entire team
imagine-ai.long_description:
Imagine AI builds B2B content pipelines for entire teams so prospects find you, trust you, and book meetings before competitors even get a reply.

Most B2B companies try LinkedIn GTM with one founder posting alone. It works, but it's slow. One voice. One network. Limited reach. One calendar for your whole team. Your CEO posts the vision, your VP of Sales posts the proof, your Head of Marketing posts the framework. Same theme, different angles, coordinated cadence. Every client gets a dedicated Content Engineer who owns your strategy with an AI platform behind them.

We serve 40+ paying B2B companies from pre-seed to publicly traded such as Rippling, Corgi Insurnace, Fondo, Campfire AI, Paramify, etc

Results across all clients:
-> $31M in revenue generated
-> 431 qualified inbounds in 1 month for one client
-> $53K inbound revenue in 1.5 weeks for another

-> 10,400 hours saved

Book a demo: https://imagineai.me 
Email: sky@imagineai.me 
Sky: https://linkedin.com/in/skyyang

anto-biosciences.name: Anto Biosciences
anto-biosciences.one_liner: A Foundation Model for Microbial Communities.
anto-biosciences.long_description:
Anto is building a foundation model for microbial communities, making the gut microbiome computable for the first time. We predict drug toxicity and efficacy across diverse populations and fix drugs so they work for everyone — solving the hidden root cause of most drug failures. 

Founded by Arvid (Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard; Nature-published researcher who pioneered quality-aware, goal-directed sparsification) and David (Harvard Medical School Gastroenterology, J&J), second-time founders who published the breakthrough at leading machine learning AI conferences and Nature.

patent-watch.name: Patent Watch
patent-watch.long_description:
We automate patent infringement detection. Our software interprets patents, identifies competing products, and generates claim charts showing who’s infringing and how.

Teams use us to:

- Find licensing and litigation targets
- Send cease-and-desist letters
- Find counter litigation
- Sell IP in wind-downs
- Accelerate M&A diligence

We also run AI invalidity and prior-art searches to help your patents hold up in court.

Companies spend up to $50k to file and maintain a single patent over its lifetime, but once it's granted, they let it collect dust. With Patent Watch, you can start turning your patent portfolio into revenue in 10 minutes.

s2-dev.name: s2.dev
s2-dev.one_liner: API for unlimited, durable, real-time streams
s2-dev.long_description:
S2 is an API for durable streams. We make working with streaming data dead simple and reliable.

The more we worked on data systems, the more we felt like there was a missing building block. The seamless experience of object storage simply did not exist for durable streams – so we set out to fix that!

S2 reimagines streams as an unlimited and access-controlled web resource. Like if Kafka and S3 had a baby.

- Building agents? Use granular streams to persist context in real time, make workflows auditable, and coordinate between agents.

- Publishing fast-moving data? Streams support high fanout and can be accessed directly over the internet, so they are a great fit for broadcasting real-time feeds.

- Sandboxing? Emit to per-instance streams, and read history or live events just as easily.

- Local-first and multiplayer experiences? Propagate updates reliably and efficiently.

Stop dealing with clusters, and start streaming.

tornyol.name: Tornyol
tornyol.one_liner: We build micro-drones that kill mosquitoes.
tornyol.long_description: Tornyol builds micro-drones that kill mosquitoes. We use smartphone microphones, car park assist sensors and some clever DSP and control to transform 40-gram toy drones into mosquito killers. Because these drones are so cheap and fast, we will lower the cost of mosquito control by 100x which will enable the eradication of mosquitoes from cities, saving more than a million people each year from Malaria, West Nile, Dengue, etc.

The hospitals we work with include Stanford Hospital, Cedars-Sinai, UCI Health, and Weill Cornell.

leadbay.name: Leadbay

leadbay.long_description:
Leadbay (YC F25) discovers and qualifies SMB leads that couldn't be found before. Small-to-enterprise teams use us to prospect the most low-data-low-signals industries like construction, hospitality, even startups.

Co-founders are Milan Stankovic (CTO) - PhD to make AI work with limited data, and Ludovic Granger (CEO). 

Try us on leadbay.ai.

pixley-ai.name: Pixley AI
pixley-ai.one_liner: The first platform where parents & kids can co-create AI cartoon shows
pixley-ai.long_description:
Pixley is the first platform where kids can turn their drawings and ideas into fully animated cartoons in minutes. In just 3 weeks after launch, over 1000 families across 75 countries have already started creating stories.

We’re starting with a clear wedge: personalized kids’ entertainment. Parents are tired of overstimulating, low-value content from YouTube and Netflix. Pixley gives them safe and personalized stories that encourage learning and imagination.

But kids’ cartoons are just the beginning. As video generation improves, all video content will shift from manual production to being personalized and generated. Our long-term goal is to build the AI Netflix: a platform where shows and movies aren’t recommended, but instead generated around each viewer’s interests and habits.

We’re 19 year old CS dropouts who’ve known each other since elementary school and won 4 hackathons at 15. After seeing AI flood the internet with low-quality content, we created Pixley – a safe, personalized way for kids to turn their ideas into animated stories.

cortex-ai.name: Cortex AI
cortex-ai.one_liner: Large-scale real-world robot & human data for embodied AI
cortex-ai.long_description:
Cortex AI builds the world’s most diverse and large-scale real-world workplace robot & egocentric dataset — where the physical world becomes the next training and evaluation set for embodied AI.

We power frontier labs developing robotics foundation models and general-purpose robots by providing the data they need:
1️⃣ Egocentric Data — real-workplace human video with hand/body pose, depth, and subtask labels.
2️⃣ Robot Data — trajectories collected from manipulators and humanoids in real industry settings.
3️⃣ Human-in-the-Loop Rollouts & Evals — real-world deployments with remote operators who recover robots when they fail, capturing data that feeds back into training and continuously improves models.

Additionally, through the Cortex Marketplace, workplaces get paid to host data-collection and evaluation sessions, while labs access the in-the-wild data that truly matters. This draws on Lucas’s previous experience as co-founder of Carousell, a C2C marketplace that scaled to a $1B+ valuation.

inspector.name: Inspector
inspector.long_description: Inspector is the AI IDE for designers to ship to prod. Just select any element on your live front end, edit it like you would in Figma, and Inspector writes the changes straight to your codebase.

thesis.name: Thesis
thesis.one_liner: An AI research lab at your fingertips.
thesis.long_description:
Our aim is to help uncover the next AlphaFold or build the next Transformer, faster, more systematically, and at scale. We treat discovery not as a matter of luck, but as an engineering challenge to be solved.

Thesis lets anyone build powerful machine learning models for anything they can imagine. The mission is to democratize invention by putting machine intelligence in everyone’s hands.

Every major breakthrough in the next decade, in science, industry, or AI, will be built on systems like Thesis. 

We intend to define that category.

oxus.name: Oxus
oxus.one_liner: AI-powered automation for internal audit workflows
oxus.long_description:
Oxus automates internal audits for pre-IPO and public companies using AI. Companies including leading payroll providers and public biotech companies work with us to streamline audit workflows and get audits done 10x faster. 

Learn more at: https://www.oxus-ai.com/

play-health.name: Play Health
play-health.long_description:
Play Health is building a perimenopause care platform to provide women and their providers with the tools they need to relieve symptoms fast. It is led by technical, second-time, YC-backed founders Andrea Mazzocchi, PhD and Ian Miller, with an exit and a unicorn between them.

Over 30 million women in the U.S. are experiencing perimenopause symptoms, spending an estimated $15B+ annually on symptom management.  Despite this most only receive generic solutions and struggle to find effective symptom relief.

We're bringing evidence-based perimenopause care to women through partnerships with medical practices and employer and health benefits programs. Our platform integrates personalized symptom, medication, and lifestyle data to generate AI-powered insights and  clinical protocols, enabling providers to deliver specialized care.

Every clinical interaction enriches our longitudinal dataset allowing us to create better outcomes for patients, deeper insights for providers, and expand into women’s health broadly. This also enables us to partner with pharma and biotech companies developing therapeutics and diagnostics for women's health.

casey.name: Casey
casey.one_liner: Casey is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage
casey.long_description: Casey is an AI-native commercial insurance broker. Our producers focus on client relationships and closing business, whilst our AI handles all the operational work behind the scenes.

selfin.name: Selfin
selfin.long_description: Selfin is developing AI-powered banking. Users can enjoy personalised recommendations and optimisations of their finances by connecting all their financial products on a single platform.

compyle.name: Compyle
compyle.one_liner: The coding agent that actually collaborates with you
compyle.long_description:
Compyle is a less autonomous coding agent that asks before it acts. We're like Cursor or Claude Code - but you won't need to rewrite your codebase every time you use it for more than a small task.

We built Compyle because we were frustrated with the direction other coding agents are headed. They're all racing to be more autonomous, running for hours without human input.

This doesn't work for real production code. When agents run autonomously, they make countless small decisions that pile up in your codebase. Engineers lose ownership - they don't know what was implemented, can't effectively debug or maintain it, and struggle to build on top of it. The code becomes a black box, and they're forced to throw it away.

Compyle keeps engineers in the driver's seat.

lexi.name: Lexi
lexi.long_description: At Lexi, we are building AI associates for Corporate Law. Our associates learn your firm's standards and improve with every case, having already handled 135,000+ documents across 7,000+ cases.

codyco.name: Codyco
codyco.one_liner: The AI Reservation Team for Hotel Groups
codyco.long_description:
€5,000 in additional bookings. In 4 weeks. For a 53-room hotel.

We help hotel groups turn missed calls into bookings.

This it how it works: 

- They send their missed calls to us.
- Our AI answers and takes the booking.
- The booking goes right into their PMS.

Even with call centers and central reservation departments they are still losing 5% of calls. 

That is a seven figure revenue leak. 

Why us? 
We used to build software that can’t fail for massive companies. We started Codyco after a friend told us how much money he was losing from missed calls. We built the first version just for him.

Now we give hotel groups the reliable AI they need, so they never lose a booking on the phone again.

complydo.name: ComplyDo

bravi.name: Bravi
bravi.one_liner: The AI operating system powering home services businesses
bravi.long_description:
Bravi is building the AI operating system for home-services businesses, using AI-powered customer communication as the wedge.

We replace the front office (calls, chats, follow-ups) with AI agents that never miss a lead, then layer an internal AI copilot that understands products, pricing, and technical documentation.

We started with fenestration (shutters, windows, garage doors), a large, complex vertical with no modern software, before expanding to adjacent trades.

Bravi is already live with leading installers and manufacturers across Europe and the US, turning missed demand into revenue.

rovr.name: Rovr
rovr.one_liner: AI FDE Engine that runs your engineering workflows
rovr.long_description: Rovr streamlines engineering operations by automating intake, triage, routing, and cross-team coordination. It replaces internal forms, manual Slack triage, and scattered docs with an AI front desk that understands requests, assigns owners, updates context, and posts status changes directly into Slack. Rovr’s built-in ops CRM gives teams a single system of record for eng requests — from tooling access to platform incidents to dev-infra workflows — reducing operational drag across the entire org.

sunflower.name: Sunflower
sunflower.one_liner: Building the Sobriety Platform for the future of Superintelligence. 🌻
sunflower.long_description:
Sunflower is on a mission to create one trillion days sober. Our product is both a consumer app (think a "Duolingo for addiction") but also with a tele-therapy clinic inside. 

Consumer App: 
- We built the #1 AI Sponsor for any kind of addiction
- Beautiful visual progression tracking to power the core "task to be done" of addiction
- A twitter style social media for addicts 
- DIY learn content (think Masterclass for addiction) for all major addiction types 
- CBT based journaling exercises 

Tele-Therapy: 
- Think a "Early Medical Peter Attia" quality of clinic, but completely focused on addiction 
- Starting with talk therapy in CA & TX we're rolling out to all 50 states + MAT 
- Bringing together the worlds best doctors to create the most effective protocol for addiction 

Sunflower went from 0 - 100k MAU in less than 6 months, and now we're continuing the traction to create the #1 product for addiction for the 1.2B humans on this planet that struggle with this fundamental human problem.

captain.name: Captain
captain.one_liner: Give AI agents accurate knowledge search that scales
captain.long_description:
Captain delivers the most accurate file search engine built for AI agents. We’ll index data from the sources folks already use like S3, SharePoint, and Google Drive, and easily scale multimodal, petabyte-level content search. We’re the Snowflake for Unstructured Data.

Captain tops the Open-RAG-Benchmark with over 20% higher accuracy than standard RAG pipelines. We achieve this through robust data processing techniques like embedding normalization across modalities, ensuring that representations cluster by semantic content rather than data type.

articulate.name: Articulate
articulate.long_description:
We help construction teams eliminate rework, delays, and drawing confusion before construction starts. We analyze PDF plans, detect clashes and inconsistencies across disciplines, and create draft RFIs so teams can resolve issues early.

This saves construction companies hundreds of hours and millions of dollars.

What we do:

- Align architectural, structural, and MEP plans so everything matches across sheets
- Generate draft RFIs from issues we find
- Replace long page-turn meetings with instant drawing analysis
- Reduce rework and prevent schedule delays before boots hit the ground

We integrate with: Procore, Autodesk, email, and the tools teams already use

Teams use us to:
- Save hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars per project
- Catch design and coordination issues early
- Reduce RFIs and prevent field fixes
- Keep projects on schedule with fewer surprises

Contact us at founders@usearticulate.com

aleph-lab.name: Aleph Lab
aleph-lab.one_liner: AI language buddy in the games kids love
aleph-lab.long_description: An AI companion that chats and plays with children inside games like Minecraft, helping them learn a new language while they play. Kids already spend hours each week in their favorite games, and now parents can turn that game time into learning time.

logical.name: Logical
logical.one_liner: A proactive desktop copilot. Clippy, but actually good.
logical.long_description: Logical is a desktop AI that acts as a proactive and largely promptless copilot, designed to reduce the friction of using AI for everyday tasks. It transfers context across apps, and allows taking action on many apps with just a few clicks. Logical can assist with drafting emails, writing docs, noting meetings and can even automatically detect action items. Need to prompt? Logical can understand intent in much fewer words than a regular chatbot. Plus, user data is never sent to Logical servers. Logical is the AI resurrection of Clippy, but actually good.

agentic-fabriq.name: Agentic Fabriq
agentic-fabriq.long_description: Agentic Fabriq is the single control plane for data permissioning throughout your entire organization across your AI and employees. Through Fabriq, any employee can tap into AI/agents with exactly the data and tools they're cleared to use by an admin. Fabriq can be used internally with employees or externally for customers while handling the auth + integrations + permissions securely for you.

travo.name: Travo
travo.one_liner: The data infrastructure for real estate
travo.long_description: We are building the most accurate and comprehensive real estate data set. Travo is the one stop shop for anyone working in real estate to search any property or parcel of land and instantly access rental comps, ownership, zoning and financials. With our data, we build the best informed AI applications for real estate private equity firms, developers, and brokers.

tensr.name: Tensr
tensr.long_description: Tensr is building fully autonomous robotic factories that make scaling hardware as effortless as scaling on AWS. We’re a group of Berkeley graduate robotics researchers who previously won a full scale autonomous IndyCar competition at 160mph.

kestrel-ai.name: Kestrel AI
kestrel-ai.long_description: Kestrel is an AI-native cloud incident response platform that brings self-healing to cloud infrastructure. It monitors cloud and kubernetes infrastructure 24/7, finds root causes, and generates exact fixes - so incidents get resolved in seconds instead of hours.

logosguard.name: LogosGuard
logosguard.one_liner: The risk management software for enterprises adopting AI
logosguard.long_description: Enterprises are racing to adopt AI, but often don't have the right controls in place or know how to verify vendors are compliant. LogosGuard turns AI policies into executable controls, stress-tests your AI products, and continuously monitors changes, giving enterprises the confidence to scale AI responsibly.

sciloop.name: Sciloop
sciloop.one_liner: Expert STEM reasoning data for frontier AI labs.
sciloop.long_description: Sciloop creates expert-level math and physics problems that frontier AI models can't solve, then sells the data to AI labs for training and evaluation. Our problems are created by IPhO and IMO medalists — the top 0.01% of STEM talent globally. On our benchmark, models like GPT 5.4 Pro and Gemini 3.1 Pro score 0-5% on our hardest problems. We work with AI labs to supply continuous, fresh training data that pushes the frontier of mathematical and scientific reasoning. Founded by Bilal and Osman, International Physics Olympiad medalists from MIT with hands-on ML research experience at MIT CSAIL.

multifactor.name: Multifactor
multifactor.one_liner: Zero-trust authentication, authorization, and auditing for AI agents
multifactor.long_description:
The agentic era is here, but its foundation is dangerously insecure. A growing number of high-profile "AI agent gone rogue" security incidents make headlines each week.

As enterprise adoption of agentic software has far outpaced the development of applicable cybersecurity solutions, CISOs have loudly voiced a growing need for verifiable, fine-grained security controls on complex multi-agent systems. That's why we built Multifactor.

Multifactor offers best-in-class authentication, authorization, and auditing technologies for agentic systems, allowing users to securely and revocably share online accounts with agents while maintaining fine-grained permissions and a detailed event history. We are doing for AI security what Cloudflare did for web security, Okta did for identity security, and Wiz did for cloud security: defining the category.

A world-class "account manager" that allows agents to securely use online accounts on your behalf is just the start—our early enterprise partners include companies using AI agents to manage $7.5+ billion manufacturing supply chains, where the consequences for lapses in security are severe. Our patented AI security technology seamlessly integrates with existing agentic software to thwart attacks like prompt injection, so CISOs and end users alike can breathe a sigh of relief, without slowing the pace of AI adoption.

allus-ai.name: Allus AI
allus-ai.one_liner: Transforming manufacturing with our next-gen Vision Foundation Model
allus-ai.long_description: Allus builds next-gen vision foundation models that bring real intelligence to manufacturing. Enabling factories to see, understand, and improve production in real time.

unsiloed-ai.name: Unsiloed AI
unsiloed-ai.one_liner: API for parsing multimodal unstructured data
unsiloed-ai.long_description:
AI teams spend 6+ months building document workflows, yet fewer than 10% ever reach production. Generic LLM parsers and OCR collapse on multimodal documents with text, tables, images, and charts. Poor parsing and suboptimal chunking cripple RAG pipelines and downstream automation. Unsiloed AI has built state-of-the-art vision models which serves as the infrastructure layer for turning unstructured data into structured, queryable, and LLM-ready assets.

Our APIs are already parsing hundreds of thousands of documents for startups and NASDAQ-listed enterprises, powering vertical AI solutions across industries. On public benchmarks, Unsiloed AI consistently outperforms solutions from LlamaIndex, Gemini, Mistral, and Unstructured.io among others.

sf-tensor.name: SF Tensor
sf-tensor.one_liner: Infrastructure for AI labs to focus on research.
sf-tensor.long_description:
AI researchers should be pushing the boundaries of what's possible with new architectures and training methods. Instead, they waste weeks configuring cloud infrastructure, debugging distributed systems, and optimizing their GPU code. We know because we lived it: While training our own models across thousands of GPUs earlier this year, we spent more time fighting our infrastructure than doing actual research.

That's why we're building two things. First, Elastic Cloud: a managed platform that automatically finds the cheapest GPUs across all providers, handles spot instance preemption, and cuts compute costs by up to 80%. Second, automatic kernel optimization that makes training code run faster by modeling hardware topology, often beating hand-tuned implementations.

The problem is that getting high performance across different hardware is genuinely hard. NVIDIA's CUDA moat exists because writing fast kernels requires deep expertise. Most teams either accept vendor lock-in or hire expensive kernel engineers. Our goal is to break the CUDA moat.

The compute bottleneck is the biggest constraint on AI progress. NVIDIA can't manufacture enough GPUs, and their monopoly keeps prices astronomical. Meanwhile, AMD, Google, and Amazon are shipping capable alternative hardware that nobody uses because the software is too hard. We're breaking that moat. If we succeed, anyone will be able to train state-of-the-art models without thinking past their PyTorch code.

answerthis.name: AnswerThis
answerthis.one_liner: End-to-end workspace to accelerate scientific discovery
answerthis.long_description:
AnswerThis is a scientific discovery platform used by over 200,000 researchers that reduces weeks of manual research work to hours. 

Instead of manually searching, reading, and organizing dozens of papers, researchers use AnswerThis to find the most relevant work, see how ideas are connected, and get comprehensive answers to complex scientific questions with line by line answers. 

This allows them to map research gaps, analyze trends, and draft literature reviews far faster, all while building a searchable library of their own research materials.

nivara.name: Nivara
nivara.one_liner: AI-powered market intelligence for the local economy
nivara.long_description: Nivara is building a revenue intelligence and signals platform for companies selling to physical businesses like home services, restaurants and healthcare.

lakonia.name: Lakonia
lakonia.one_liner: Delivering AI-powered situational awareness in tactical environments.
lakonia.long_description: Lakonia is building an AI-powered command and control platform for law enforcement and the military. Our AI transcribes radio communications, analyzes them, and then synthesizes information for commanders/dispatchers and operators to act on.

sellraze.name: SellRaze
sellraze.one_liner: The fastest way to sell online.
sellraze.long_description:
SellRaze is an AI-powered selling assistant that helps anyone sell anything in seconds. Point your camera at any item and we'll identify it, price it, and create an engaging listing across multiple marketplaces, including our own.

Each day, more than 2,500 items are added to SellRaze, representing over $326,000 in inventory value.

mod-ai.name: Mod AI
mod-ai.long_description:
We're building the first fully autonomous accounts payable platform.

Our AI clerks handle your entire AP workflow: invoice processing, GL coding, PO matching, approvals, responding to vendors, fraud detection and reporting. From the moment an invoice hits your inbox to the moment it's paid, no manual steps required.

We integrate with 16+ ERPs including QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Dynamics 365, and Workday.

Find out why enterprise teams choose Mod AI at usemod.ai.

semble-ai.name: Semble AI
semble-ai.one_liner: Autonomous building-system design for construction companies.
semble-ai.long_description:
Semble AI builds AI agents that design building-systems (fire, HVAC, plumbing, security). Construction companies use Semble to cut down weeks on commercial and residential projects. 

The $600B building-system integration industry still runs on spreadsheets and manual drawings, even as building codes rapidly evolve and become more localized. It’s a massive blind spot for the tech world. 

Jonathan and Ethan met studying computer science at Stanford. Jonathan worked at Convergint, one of the world's largest building system integrators, specifically for the purpose of learning how this industry works. Ethan is obsessed for a different reason: His house burned down in a wildfire in 2017.

They are determined to make Semble the industry standard for construction design.

flick.name: Flick
flick.long_description:
Flick is an AI filmmaking software that lets people create Hollywood-level short films completely using AI end-to-end.

There are many AI tools that can give you 8-second casual clips to post on social media, but when it comes to creating truly high-quality films with coherent storylines, consistent characters, and cinematic aesthetics, they don’t come close due to their lack of flexibility, creative control, and fragmented creative flow.

Founded by an award-winning filmmaker and a founding engineer at Instagram, Flick defines an interface specifically designed for native AI filmmaking that feels natural and enables end-to-end creative flows. Think of Flick as Figma for AI filmmaking.

There are 4 complete AI short films created using Flick that got 20+ awards in international film festivals already and our early creator residency community are generating several AI short films every week.

We are also building a community where we produce our own AI films as well as collaborating with other well-known filmmakers to share their “behind-the-scenes” workflows as resuable templates to inspire users in our community. We not only build product, we also build world-class content.

The whole film industry will be revolutionized by AI and our goal is to be “the product” that defines this category.

hillclimb.name: hillclimb
hillclimb.long_description: We work with frontier AI labs to help train their agents to become AI research scientists

atlasgrid.name: AtlasGrid
atlasgrid.long_description: AtlasGrid automatically builds a visual graph of your mobile app UI and displays analytics directly on your screens. Additionally, our fleet of AI-powered agents will continuously analyze thousands of mobile apps, gathering design insights and identifying growth opportunities + actionable product improvements.

wardstone.name: Wardstone
wardstone.long_description: Wardstone is a space defense-tech company developing next-generation capabilities to protect the United States and its allies from missiles and other space-based threats. We design, build, and deploy satellites equipped with space-based interceptors to kinetically counter hypersonic and ballistic missiles.

nessie.name: Nessie
nessie.long_description:
Nessie is building personal AI brains that augment human cognition.

Nessie turns your scattered AI conversations and documents into a shareable AI brain you actually own. It's a thinking partner that lets you instantly search your entire history of ideas, synthesize them into new insights, and watch your knowledge build on itself over time.

Right now, your best thinking is trapped in ephemeral AI chat histories. Nessie unifies your context from ChatGPT, Claude, and (soon) Apple Notes/Google Docs/Notion/other context sources, auto-organizing the mess into an AI-enhanced brain.

Next, we are unlocking sharing. Instead of sending a static doc, you will be able to send your "Product Strategy Brain" to a cofounder, or publish your "Research Brain" for your entire team to chat with.

Who it's for: AI-native thinkers—founders, researchers, and writers—who believe their best ideas should compound.

The Team: We are two Yale CS grads and former Amazon engineers building the tool we needed for ourselves. We combine Anna's obsession with neuroscience and augmenting human cognition with Tiger's lifelong passion for building products (he shipped an app with 70k+ users at age 13).

Traction: Launched 3 weeks ago. We have over 1,200 users who have imported 300,000+ AI conversations into Nessie. 30% week-over-week organic user growth.

Origin Story: Nessie was born after we hit the 1-million-token limit in multiple Gemini chats. Overnight, months of research disappeared. We realized the problem wasn't just about storage; it was that the medium for AI-native thought didn't exist yet. The chat window is a place to ask questions, not a place to build a mind.

Our Vision: We are building a new medium for personal intelligence. Everyone will have an AI brain on Nessie. You will use it to think better, remember more, and share your mind with the world.

hypercubic.name: Hypercubic
hypercubic.one_liner: AI to maintain and modernize COBOL.
hypercubic.long_description:
Hypercubic is an AI-native maintenance and modernization platform for COBOL and mainframes.

We help enterprises understand and preserve their mission-critical legacy systems. About 70% of the Fortune 500 companies still rely on them to run their core business applications in banking, insurance, telecom, airlines, retail, and more.

These systems, originally built in the 1960s–90s, still power trillions in global infrastructure today but have become increasingly opaque as original developers retire or leave the workforce. 

We're laying the foundation to autonomously maintain and modernize these legacy systems to future-proof the backbone of the global economy.


Learn more at hypercubic.ai

cranston-ai.name: Cranston AI
cranston-ai.long_description:
Cranston is a full stack AI accounting firm automating the $900b market for accounting labor. Our software automates reconciliation, tax compliance and financial analysis for startups & SMBs. We pull in context from all your company's apps & data, connect to existing systems of record and handle repetitive accounting work.

Our team is deep in the accounting space. Sean spent 5 years building an ERP after dropping out of Stanford and Max spent 5 years building an accounting firm that did every accounting workflow you can imagine on top of ERPs.

trelium.name: Trelium
trelium.one_liner: The Agent to Build Your Agents

velum-labs.name: Velum Labs
velum-labs.one_liner: The OS for data quality across any stack
velum-labs.long_description:
Velum is the operating system for data quality. Velum automatically monitors and enforces data quality across a company's data stack, so bad data never reaches dashboards. We turn data quality from a manual task into infrastructure that runs itself.

Data trust you can prove. From the pipeline to the boardroom.

veria-labs.name: Veria Labs
veria-labs.one_liner: Continuous AI pentesting that finds and fixes vulnerabilities
veria-labs.long_description:
Veria Labs is developing AI agents that hack better than the best human hackers. Founded by members of the #1 US competitive hacking team, we've already found critical bugs in AI tools, operating systems, fintech and billion dollar crypto exchanges. 

Now we're scaling that expertise through AI-native security tooling that operates faster than human researchers while finding deeper, more complex vulnerabilities that traditional tools miss.

minro.name: Minro
minro.long_description:
Minro observes how you handle your day - how you reply, decide, prioritize - and prepares the next set of actions. Our key insight: if you model real behavior, you can replicate judgment, not just tasks using personal agents and knowledge graphs. Iris knows what needs your attention across your accounts, pre-fills the actions, and you can simply swipe right to hand it off to your agent.

We started with connecting calendars and emails. We launched four weeks ago. Over 1,200 people have downloaded Iris, 168 use it every day, and they’ve taken more than 36,000 actions so far growing 48% week over week.

In the future, everyone will have a personal proxy running their digital life with near perfect accuracy. Iris is the first real version of that future.

playvision.name: PlayVision
playvision.long_description:
PlayVision is the AI Moneyball for Sports: the future for scouting, recruiting, and playing the game.

Basketball teams upload their practices or games, and PlayVision uses AI and computer vision to automatically tag and analyze the film, giving coaches and scouts 10 times the information on their players and their opponents. PlayVision also uses algorithms to rank every single college and professional basketball player in the country with over 40 different metrics from tracking and play-by-play data. 

Check out our website at withplayvision.ai, and follow our instagram @playvisionai!

koyal.name: Koyal
koyal.long_description:
Koyal is an Agentic AI Filmmaking Platform that allows you to seamlessly convert script or audio into personalized, visually compelling stories. We’re a team from Carnegie Mellon, MIT and Meta, with experience in AI video generation.

https://koyal.ai builds directly upon our published research at the AI conference NeurIPS in December. We’ve been covered in the international press for our patented secure personalization protocol CHARCHA: the genAI captcha.

Announcement: https://x.com/meh_agarwal/status/1965866965425348687
Demo: https://x.com/meh_agarwal/status/1965137062119752099


We currently have paid pilots with the biggest global music labels, podcasts and production houses, and just launched our public beta at beta.koyal.ai

We recently concluded a pilot with Universal Music and T-Series (world’s largest music label) alongside Bollywood production houses like Maddock Entertainment, and Collective Artists Network! As part of that, we launched 5 music videos for Grammy and Oscar winning artists like A R Rahman, Ricky Kej and Shankar Mahadevan all crossing 1.5 million views!

We've recently built SOTA capabilities in (i) multilingual script to audio to video, (ii) Agentic lip-sync with dynamic movement & (iii) Multi-character consistency.

kaigo-health.name: Kaigo Health
kaigo-health.long_description: Kaigo Health provides an AI-powered outpatient care management platform that automates and scales remote care management for Medicare patients including post-discharge followups, ongoing check-ins, and monitoring. Using phone calls as an age-friendly interface, we aggregate patient responses, voice biomarkers, and remote patient monitoring data for powerful preventative and proactive healthcare.

norra.name: Norra
norra.one_liner: Automating equipment operations for nursing facilities
norra.long_description: Norra helps nursing facilities manage equipment operations. Every year, ~$80 billion are spent on medical equipment like beds, concentrators, and wheelchairs. Nursing facilities continue to operate with zero visibility which leads to $15 billion in equipment waste annually. We use physical trackers and AI agents to eliminate this.

soren.name: Soren
soren.long_description: Soren develops private AI infrastructure for teams in regulated industries. We make it possible for organizations to adopt modern AI without worrying about data privacy or security.

lunavo.name: Lunavo
lunavo.one_liner: Lunavo is the AI assistant for carriers.
lunavo.long_description:
We build AI that runs carrier operations.

Lunavo is the AI assistant for carriers. It plugs directly into their existing toolstack, understands their processes, and monitors all incoming data and requests. Lunavo runs end-to-end backoffice operations, handling repetitive tasks, resolving issues autonomously, and escalating only what matters.

Lunavo helps carriers scale operations without scaling headcount.

dari.name: Dari
dari.one_liner: An API to build the most reliable browser use agents
dari.long_description:
A platform where users can automate web workflows using natural language prompts.

We handle deterministic playback of browser workflows and fall back to LLMs where necessary, ensuring reliability.

the-context-company.name: The Context Company
the-context-company.one_liner: Monitor AI agents and understand user behavior
the-context-company.long_description:
Understand user patterns and find silent failures in your AI agents.

The Context Company helps teams analyze AI agent conversations to surface user behavior patterns, performance trends, and moments where agents struggle - so teams know what’s working, what’s not, and what to improve next.

We turn raw conversations into structured signals: topic clustering, user feedback analysis, custom pattern tracking, and alerts. All alongside traditional observability like traces, tool calls, latency, and costs.

Get started in less than 10 lines of code.

sorce.name: Sorce
sorce.long_description: Tinder for Jobs. Swipe right, AI applies on your behalf.

caddy.name: Caddy
caddy.one_liner: The voice interface that works proactively for you
caddy.long_description:
Caddy is the operating system that works proactively for you. It learns how you work and acts on your behalf, keeping work moving while your context and voice stay intact.

Instead of producing generic AI output, Caddy creates real work artifacts that sound like you and fit how you actually work. Today, it operates across the tools you use every day, including email, calendar, Slack, Linear, and Notion.

Caddy is built by the team behind Loom’s AI and core product. We believe the next era of computing is software that understands intent, handles ambiguous work, and quietly gets work done in the background.

alt-x.name: Alt-X
alt-x.one_liner: Automation for institutional-grade financial modeling in Excel
alt-x.long_description:
Alt-X is building the Cursor for financial modeling in Excel, an Excel agent that you can actually trust.

Private-market investing still runs on Excel. Every year, trillions of dollars in real estate and private-equity deals are underwritten through manual spreadsheet work — copying numbers from PDFs, CIMs, and data rooms into fragile models that analysts rebuild from scratch.

Alt-X is the AI underwriting layer for Excel. It turns raw deal materials into clean, auditable financial models inside Excel, automatically extracting key metrics and generating institutional-grade underwriting models that analysts can immediately review and edit.

Building reliable AI workflows for financial models is difficult. Underwriting models contain thousands of interdependent formulas across multiple sheets, and small errors can materially change investment decisions. Alt-X focuses on making model generation and data extraction reliable enough for real deal workflows, not just demos. We built our product to underwrite billions.

Ryan Samadi (Stanford CS/AI, former Citadel trader) and Michael Wachsmann (Cornell CS, infrastructure engineer) have spent years building systems around financial data and modeling workflows.
We have hundreds of millions in AUM using us already, and our users already prefer us to legacy cash flow modeling tools in the real estate space.

Private markets remain one of the largest manual workflows in finance. Alt-X’s goal is to become the default infrastructure layer for underwriting private-market investments inside Excel.

locus.name: Locus
locus.long_description:
We make your agents pay.

As agents evolve from tools into dependable, autonomous actors, they’ll need the ability to execute open-ended workflows end-to-end.

This inevitably means payments: accessing paywalled data, transacting for services or with other specialist agents. But autonomy requires guardrails. Businesses and developers will need a way to ensure their agents only spend how much and on what they’re supposed to.

The machine economy is coming, and Locus (YC F25) is building the connector businesses will need to participate. We connect agents securely to funds, letting you define permissions and limits for every transaction. Each payment is traceable, auditable, and fully reconcilable with your existing financial stack.

deeptrace.name: Deeptrace
deeptrace.long_description:
At Deeptrace, we’re building AI agents that investigate and resolve production alerts end-to-end. Deeptrace cuts through the noise, pinpoints root causes instantly, and gives engineering teams back what they need most: the freedom to build instead of firefighting.

In production, we're already seeing a reduction in time spent triaging, investigating, and resolving alerts with some of the fastest growing companies in the world.

aspect-inc.name: Aspect
aspect-inc.one_liner: AI Visual Understanding for Multimodal Data
aspect-inc.long_description:
With our visual understanding engine & platform, Aspect processes dense multimodal datasets, providing tools for segmentation, QC, structured schema extraction. 

Companies today have access to Glean and Notion Agents for working with vast text corpuses - Aspect is enabling that for multimodal data.

scoop.name: Scoop
scoop.one_liner: Automating regulatory submissions for life sciences
scoop.long_description: We’re building AI agents that speed up drug trials by automating the manual consolidation and document prep required for every IND submission. Today, biotechs spend months stitching together reports from contractors and internal teams just to file and get to their first-in-human trial.

hyperspell.name: Hyperspell
hyperspell.long_description:
Hyperspell is the Memory & Context Layer for AI Agents.

AI agents are clueless geniuses. They crush humans on any standardized test, but wouldn't last a day at a real job. What today's super-intelligent agents are missing is the real world context they are operating in. A context that humans stitch together from hundreds of data points across dozens of interactions and channels. A context that grows with their tasks.

Hyperspell gives AI agents this context by connecting to their user’s workspace data and building a personalized memory and context layer.

bolna-ai.name: Bolna AI
bolna-ai.one_liner: Voice AI to enable India's next billion
bolna-ai.long_description:
Bolna handles the complexity of voice infra, so enterprises can automate calls faster, better, and cheaper, at scale

Bolna is a Voice AI Orchestration platform purpose-built for Indian enterprises.
Businesses in India run tens of thousands of calls every day - across sales, support, collections, recruitment, and more. Bolna gives them the power to build and deploy Voice AI Agents directly from their transcripts and FAQs, so they can start automating calls immediately.

With Bolna, enterprises get:

1. Full control over agent intelligence, tone, and workflows
2. Cost efficiency at scale with smart routing across providers and price points
3. Enterprise-grade performance on latency, interruptions, multi-language, and multi-accent understanding

gpt.name: Nexus
gpt.one_liner: We help non-technical teams build AI agents without engineers
gpt.long_description: Nexus enables non-technical teams in large organizations to build production-ready AI agents without code.

zavo.name: Zavo
zavo.one_liner: AI Point of Sale for Restaurants
zavo.long_description:
Zavo is the first AI-point of sale platform for restaurants.

We unify payments, point of sale, and AI agents into one seamless platform, allowing business to accept payments, manage operations and automate manual processes with Ai. 

From reservations, to payments to point of sale, we have built the full restaurant tech stack in-house with AI automation across all products.

We started Zavo in May 2025, currently over 400 businesses of different sizes use Zavo to accept payments and manage operations

movedot.name: MOVEdot
movedot.long_description: Our agents run hardware engineering tasks that normally take hours or days in just a few minutes, allowing engineers to process 100x more data and information. Our platform allows hardware engineers to orchestrate agents for tasks such as analyzing failures across entire test campaigns, pulling the right data and KPIs from their databases, checking how conditions (like temperature or load) affect performance and reliability, and then document findings in reports and dashboards.

parrot.name: Parrot
parrot.long_description: Parrot is the TikTok for language learning. We turn doomscrolling into fluency with personalized short-form videos. Power users scroll for 6 hours/week on Parrot. Our team of engineers have lived the frustration of ineffective apps and learning methods - we’re building the first language platform that actually works.

brickwise.name: Brickwise
brickwise.one_liner: AI property manager for landlords and estate agents
brickwise.long_description:
We've built an AI property manager that automates maintenance requests, handling tenant calls and messages 24/7, following up by chasing contractors and resolving issues.

We're based in London, but have over 10 customers throughout the world, from San Francisco to Dubai. We have a reliable sales pipeline, including a >$1m cARR enterprise contract. Since our formation 6 months ago, we have raised over $3M in funding.

Ismail, co-founder & CEO, is an ex-Founder at LiveLink AI, where he raised $3M, growing the platform to editing 150k videos per month. He also built his own prop firm to $500k ARR.

Elias, co-founder & CTO, was an early engineer at a YC backed company, acquired by Google. While a senior engineer at Google for 5 years, he took the product from $50k ARR to >$100m. CS at Bristol, MBA from Imperial.
brickwise.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

parse-bot.name: Parse
parse-bot.one_liner: Build an API to interact with any website.
parse-bot.long_description: Parse lets developers build APIs for any website. Unlike traditional scraping tools that rely on slow, expensive headless browsers, Parse examines websites' underlying network requests and generates API endpoints automatically. This makes Parse 10-100x faster and cheaper than browser automation,.

structured-ai.name: Structured AI
structured-ai.long_description:
Structured AI is building the AI workforce for construction design engineering, starting with AI agents that perform quality control on technical documents and drawings. Our agents learn your standards, apply the right building codes, and automatically review your drawings, so you see fewer clashes, fewer inconsistencies, and fewer costly RFIs and change orders.

⚙️ Automates QA/QC across mechanical, electrical, structural and more
🧩 Used by multi-disciplinary design firms to deliver projects faster with less risk
🚀 Mission: Free engineers to focus on creative design, not repetitive admin

uplane.name: Uplane
uplane.long_description:
Uplane replaces marketing agencies with AI. We generate hundreds of ads with matching landing pages and steer the ad spend across channels like Meta, Google, LinkedIn and others. By connecting to CRM and ERP data, Uplane learns what drives profits and continuously improves campaigns.

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by replacing a patchwork of agencies, spreadsheets, and siloed tools with one self-improving system. The result: Higher ROAS for enterprises and effortless, expert-level marketing for SMBs.

aircaps.name: AirCaps
aircaps.one_liner: The AI copilot for in-person conversations.
aircaps.long_description:
AirCaps is bringing AI assistance to in-person conversations. 

Our AI-copilot provides live captions, translations, AI meeting notes and insights for in-person conversations in real-time. It's deployed as an app for lightweight AR glasses so you can see visual information overlaid onto your field of vision.

You can think of it like a Zoom AI meeting assistant or Granola, but for in-person conversations, and with the ability to proactively help you in real-time, not just after the conversation.

We’re building the capture and intelligence layer for the 216 billion daily conversations that happen face-to-face.

We’ve already processed 16,500 hours of real-world conversations and counting. Today, AirCaps assists with 11% of our users’ in-person conversations.

We did $93K in revenue in October and grew 6.5x from September while spending <$3K on marketing (and hit $70K in revenue in the first 2 weeks of November). Our power users average 6h+ daily usage and our day-30 retention is 91%.

We previously went viral (75M+ views on TikTok, 150K+ followers) and have been featured by The New Yorker, WIRED, and Forbes.

Madhav (CEO, Yale CS) has been building in audio and AR since age 13, starting with Google Glass apps and voice assistants for Raspberry Pis. He researched audio AI at the MIT Media Lab. Nirbhay (CTO, Cornell CS) built voice AI on smart glasses in high school and built conversational AI products as the first engineer at 2 YC startups.

brickanta.name: Brickanta
brickanta.long_description: Brickanta  – agentic AI for society builders. Hundreds of construction-specific AI agents for project analysis, insights, tenders, procurement, and more. Combine the latest AI technology with your organization's project data, templates, and workflows to identify risks and opportunities early and produce better decision support. Brickanta has raised $8 million from leading AI, construction, and real estate investors behind companies like OpenAI/ChatGPT, Airbnb, Klarna, Spotify, and Plangrid-Autodesk, as well as star investors such as Mario Götze, Anton Osika, and Northzone (see movie and press). The founding team has been building and implementing AI in construction and industry since 2018 at companies such as ABB, Fabege, Husqvarna, IKEA and Konecranes.

f2.name: F2
f2.one_liner: The AI platform for private markets investors
f2.long_description:
F2 is the AI platform for private markets investors. Purpose-built for private credit, private equity, and commercial banking, F2 accelerates diligence, underwriting, and portfolio monitoring, helping teams evaluate deals over 60% faster. 

F2 turns unstructured deal data into investment-grade analysis and polished memos in minutes. Unlike general-purpose AI, F2 is built with the domain expertise and depth to handle the most complex financial analysis. Already trusted across thousands of deals, F2 makes collaboration easy and retains historical context, so past work compounds into future wins. 

Headquartered in New York City, F2 is backed by leading investors including NFX, Left Lane Capital, and Y Combinator.

remedy.name: Remedy
remedy.long_description: Streamline prescription refills, reduce workload, and enhance patient care with intelligent automation.

semiotic.name: Semiotic
semiotic.long_description:
Semiotic builds AI design agents. We’re starting with agents that build landing pages for fast‑growing startups. 

Existing AI website builders didn't make creating websites easier—they made creating ugly websites easier. So, companies choose between blue-purple gradient slop or agencies with 3-month waitlists and $100k minimums.

You don't have to choose anymore. 

Start a project: semiotic.com

lapis.name: Lapis
lapis.one_liner: AI that creates on-brand image ads
lapis.long_description:
Lapis gives businesses the ability to generate on-brand advertising creatives using AI. It uses existing assets like logos, colors, fonts, and product images, and automatically creates image ads that match a company's visual identity and voice across Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and Google.

With Lapis, businesses can rapidly iterate on creatives and A/B test at scale without being bottlenecked by design and creative capacity.

Lapis is used by 1,000+ marketing teams, from big businesses like Hyundai and Tata to small businesses around the world, and supports 15+ languages including English, Spanish, and Italian.

nox-metals.name: Nox Metals
nox-metals.long_description: Nox Metals is an AI-powered metals supplier powering modern American manufacturing at scale. We are building automated factories that turn raw metal into production-ready material faster, cheaper, and more reliably than legacy service centers.

digipals.name: Digipals
digipals.one_liner: The future of Social in the age of AI
digipals.long_description:
Social networks are dead. Social media became more media than social. My friends aren't on social media anymore - it's one third ads, one third content from strangers, and one third AI slop. Our social lives are fragmented across dozens of different apps - iMessage, WhatsApp, Find My, Partiful, and Venmo. 

Digipals is the first AI-native social operating system that improves our relationships with friends. We built ambient AI agents that use social context from our location, calendar, and photos to take action and write code in our group chats. We are the last social platform anyone will ever need.

Launch Video
https://youtu.be/KW2tjLl6sxM

blue.name: Blue
blue.one_liner: Your phone finally has someone to run it. Plug in Blue, just ask.
blue.long_description:
Everyone pays someone to handle the parts of their life that don't need them personally. The cleaner, the bookkeeper, the lawn service. Nobody could handle what lives in your phone. Until Blue.

Blue is a small USB-C dongle and iPhone app. Plug it in and say what needs doing. The follow-up you haven't sent, the appointment you haven't booked, the reply you owe. Blue opens the right app, does the work, and tells you when it's done. You don't touch your phone.

Works with every app already on your iPhone. 

The team brings complementary experience at scale: Omar Abdelaziz led Google Assistant’s transition to LLMs and holds one of earliest patents in LLM-based computer control; Peter Krogh spent decades designing voice-first dialog systems and was most recently a design lead at Google DeepMind building actions for Gemini Live; Muhammad Farhan Hossain helped ship Apple Vision Pro, is named on dozens of hardware/systems patents, and has led products from prototype to mass production.

We’ve built systems used by billions. Now we’re on to defining the next era of computing.

mixy.name: Mixy
mixy.one_liner: Make mashups without knowing how to DJ
mixy.long_description:
Live out your DJ dreams with Mixy, the mind-blowing music app that lets you mash-up any song in seconds.

⁕ Add your songs
⁕ Instantly blend vocals and beats
⁕ Play and share your mashup anywhere

There’s no limit to your imagination!

⁕ Launched to #1 in Music on June 19th
⁕ 1.5M users in 3 months
⁕ 15M mashups made and growing

paloma.name: Paloma
paloma.one_liner: AI-native CRM for putting post-sales operations on autopilot
paloma.long_description: We unify your contracts, service consumption, and customer relationship context so that your revenue, success and sales teams can operate from the same ground truth.
